Corrigido e no ar, meu camarada. O bug do `/devthink/panel` alternando entre os ícones e o painel era um **loop de rota infinito**, e a causa raiz era essa:

**O que estava acontecendo** — o painel ainda usava o mecanismo antigo do workbench: ao entrar, ele empurrava a rota interna `/w/<ids>/...` no histórico e o "selo deep" reescrevia a barra de volta para `/panel` com `replaceState`. O wouter espia `pushState`/`replaceState`, então essa reescrita CRUA realimentava o roteador: a localização interna virava `/panel`, o painel remontava, o bootstrap empurrava `/w/...` de novo, o selo devolvia para `/panel`... um ping-pong de ~60ms que ficava remontando a tela inteira (daí a alternância visual e do path). Cheguei a medir **~140 viradas em 12 segundos** no traço ao vivo.

**A correção** (commit a4832353, CI/Family Pages verdes) — mudei a lei de endereço do desktop: a rota do painel agora é **estado React** (`useState` inicializado dos ids do deep link ou do `dt.local.route`), os ids moram no `sessionStorage`, e **nenhum effect escreve mais histórico para `/w/...`**. O deep link entra uma vez, sela a barra em `/panel` (uma única transição, que o roteador absorve) e tudo depois disso (trocar aba, abrir providers/settings, sessão do gateway) muda só o estado — a barra fica limpa e o router nunca mais é esbaldroado entre dois Route elements.

**Verificado ao vivo** — na aba limpa com o bundle novo (`index-CGdQdtkp.js`): traço de história com **zero transições**, path fixo em `/devthink/panel`, desktop com os 23 ícones e as janelas que você tinha deixado abertas (a Docs coberta no print é o layout persistido, não bug). A aba que estava presa no loop (o renderizador tinha saturado com o bundle velho em cache) eu fechei e reabri limpa — se alguma aba sua ainda estiver piscando, **um recarregar resolve**, porque o index.html em cache expira sozinho (Pages segura 10 min).

Detalhe honesto: com essa mudança, voltar com o botão **Back** do navegador agora sai do app em vez de reabrir o workspace anterior — é o preço de a barra nunca mais mentir sobre onde você está; os ids continuam no HD e no `dt.local.route`, então a sessão reidrata na próxima visita.

## 1) INGESTÃO — análise/decomposição real (stems, HPSS, features) e schemas JSON exatos

Há **três motores de ingestão reais**, com schemas de saída distintos:

### 1a. Ingestão Node (ffmpeg + FFT) — `mjs/analyser.mjs`, `mjs/dsp.mjs`, `mjs/ffmpeg.mjs`
- `ffmpeg.mjs` decodifica de verdade para PCM float: `decodeToPCM()` roda `ffmpeg -f f32le -acodec pcm_f32le -ar 22050 -ac 1` e monta `Float32Array` do buffer; `probeJSON()` roda ffprobe; `ebur128()` parseia loudness (LUFS/LRA/peak) do stderr.
- `analyser.mjs` faz STFT real (fft.js, frame 2048, hop 512, Hann) e extrai por frame: RMS, spectral centroid, flatness, energias por banda (sub 20-60, bass 60-250, low 250-500, mid 500-2k, high 2k-10k, presence 1k-16k), pitch por autocorrelação (lags 50–800 Hz), onsets por *spectral flux* na banda grave (20–250 Hz, picos > 15% do máximo) e BPM pela mediana dos intervalos (fold de oitavas 40–220). Esquema de saída exato (o mesmo dos JSONs gigantes de `json/`):

```js
result = {
  file, length_sec, sample_rate, channels, format,
  global: { bpm, bpm_estimated, average_pitch_hz, average_centroid_hz,
            average_flatness, scale_guess: {key, mode:'minor (trap guess)'}, suggested_key },
  per_second: [ { second, rms:{mean,min,max}, centroid:{...}, flatness:{...},
                  pitch:{mean,min,max}|null, bands:{mean:{sub..presence},max,min},
                  dominant_band } ]
}
// + analise-master.json = { analysed_at, source_dir, count, tracks:[{file,global}], full:[...] }
```

- Evidência de execução real com bug: `json/analise-master.json` (1,6 MB) contém BPM absurdos (369.1, 2584.0) para "atm [voice].wav" — saída crua do pipeline, sem pós-correção.
- `dsp.mjs` é uma biblioteca irmã (STFT recursiva Cooley-Tukey, centroid, flatness, bandEnergies, onsetDetection, bpmFromOnsets), mas o `realFFT` iterativo está **incompleto/quebrado** (`const r1 || continue;` — throw "Use external FFT").

### 1b. Ingestão browser (6 stems + features) — `v1/v1/src/app/page.tsx` (~2.348 linhas)
Pipeline `handleAudioUpload` → `analyzeSecond` → `buildCamada`. Decodifica com `AudioContext.decodeAudioData`, separa **6 camadas por DSP real** (biquads Butterworth escritos à mão, 2× cascata):

```ts
const runFilterDSP = (samples, type, sampleRate) => {
  switch (type) {
    case 'bass':       return applyGain(lowPass(samples, 250, sampleRate), 2.0);
    case 'beats':      { const lp = lowPass(samples, 150, sampleRate);
                         return applyGain(transientEnhance(lp), 3.0); }
    case 'guitars':    return applyGain(bandPass(samples, 250, 2500, sampleRate), 1.5);
    case 'vocals':     return applyGain(bandPass(samples, 300, 4000, sampleRate), 1.8);
    case 'percussion': { const hp = highPass(samples, 5000, sampleRate);
                         return applyGain(transientEnhance(hp), 4.0); }
    case 'effects':    return applyGain(bandPass(samples, 1500, 9000, sampleRate), 2.0);
```

Features por segundo: Meyda (`rms, spectralFlatness, spectralCentroid, zcr, chroma, amplitudeSpectrum, mfcc`) + **Pitchfinder YIN** (ESM) para F0; deriva rolloff 85/95%, spread/skew/kurtosis, entropy, HFC, crest, onsets por RMS sub-janela (subRms > prev*1.6), BPM **local por segundo** (autocorrelação em janela deslizante ±2s do envelope RMS a 100 Hz), detecção de loop (correlação do downsampling de 400 amostras vs. histórico, gaps 4/8, limiar 0.78), notas MIDI por camada tonal (`detectMidiNotes`: janelas 80ms/hop 40ms, agrupa MIDI estável → tuplas `[midi, startMs, durMs, vel]`), e classificação de instrumento **por regras de features reais** (YAMNet removido explicitamente por CORS): ex. Kick = `centroid<200 && pitch<120`; Hi-Hat = `centroid>4000 && flatness>0.5`; Synth Bass = `flatness<0.1 && centroid<300`, etc. Processa em fases de 30 s (6 fases p/ 3 min), liberando preview no 1º batch.

### 1c. Ingestão browser "vector-one" — `v2/src/lib/audio/{dsp,analysis,embedding}.ts`
- `dsp.ts`: FFT real (fft.js, FFT_SIZE 2048, HOP 512, Hann), spectral flux, centroid, rolloff 85%, flatness (geom/ari), bandas [low<250, mid<2000, high] normalizadas, **pitch por autocorrelação normalizada (YIN-lite) com refinamento parabólico** (`bestVal < 0.45 → null`), chroma 12 bins 55–5000 Hz, e um **embedding de 32 dimensões** documentado: `[0-11]=chroma, 12-15=espectral, 16-19=ritmo, 20-23=dinâmica, 24-27=registro, 28-31=temporal`.
- `analysis.ts` (`analyzeAudioBuffer`): onsets globais por flux adaptativo (`flux > média*1.8 && > 0.004`), BPM por mediana de IOI (fold 80–190), eventos por segundo classificados por energia de banda (`lb[0]>0.62 → kick`, `lb[2]>0.5 && lb[0]<0.4 → hat`, senão `hit`) + nota dominante, e assina o documento com **Zod**: `TimelineSchema.parse()` — contrato `"vector-one/timeline@5.0"`:

```ts
TimelineSchema = { schema:"vector-one/timeline@5.0", source:"import"|"generated"|"variation",
  bpm: 30..300, seconds, embedding: number[32],
  frames: [ { s, rms, centroid, flux, chroma[12], embedding[32],
              events: [ { kind:"note"|"transient", note?, pitch?, onset, velocity, confidence, hz? } ],
              tags: ["ritmico","melodico","grave","energico"] } ] }
```

- `embedding.ts` tem `timelineToProject()`: detecção de tonalidade pelo cromagrama (3ª maior vs menor), suavização por mediana 3-janelas, quantização à escala + fold de registro (±6 semitons da mediana global, clamp 48–84), merge de notas repetidas, groove 16 steps aprendido por frequência de onset (limiar 0.22/s), bass a cada 2 compassos na tônica (`root+36`), pads a cada 4. Até 96 compassos (duração completa).

### 1d. HPSS real (Node, WAV de 48 kHz) — doc `15-separacao-hpss-phase-cancellation.md`
Script `tools/separar-real.cjs` (não incluído, mas o doc carrega o algoritmo): Mid/Side (`mid=(L+R)/2`, `side=(L-R)/2`), **HPSS-like por média móvel centrada 30 ms** (1.440 samples @48k): `harmonic = moving_average(mid, 1440)`, `percussive = mid - harmonic`; depois biquads RBJ por stem (vocals: harmonic 250–4000 Hz; bass: harmonic 30–250 Hz; drums: percussive 30–8000 Hz; outros: side + harmonic 4–12 kHz); normalização peak 0.5/stem. Validação real com métricas: cross-correlação entre stems < 0.25, energia por banda (Goertzel 7 bandas), reconstrução via `amix` (RMS -26.68 dB vs original -10.06 dB). Limitação declarada: elementos no mesmo range espectral E mesmo pan são matematicamente inseparáveis; ML (Demucs via `@xenova/transformers`) falhou (401 no HF Hub).

## 2) ARMAZENAMENTO — PCM/JSON: IndexedDB, chaves, hex, base64, prisma/drizzle

### 2a. IndexedDB via localforage (v1 e v2)
`v1/v1/src/app/pcm-store.ts` (e duplicado inline no page.tsx):

```ts
const pcmStore = localforage.createInstance({
  name: 'AudioEnginePro', storeName: 'pcmStreams',
  description: 'PCM Float32 streams indexed by session:second:track',
});
const makeKey = (sessionId, second, track) => `${sessionId}:${second}:${track}`;
export const storePcmStream = async (sessionId, second, track, pcm) =>
  pcmStore.setItem(makeKey(...), pcm);          // Float32Array via structured clone
export const getPcmStream  = async (...)        // getItem → Float32Array|null
export const clearSessionPcmStreams = ...       // keys().filter(startsWith(sessionId))
```
Histórico v1: antes convertia PCM→**hex string** (~352 KB/camada/seg, concat O(n²)) e o comentário menciona "Base64 bagunçado" substituído por hex; a v2 anti-OOM guarda Float32Array direto + **pré-carga lazy de 5 s + cache LRU de 30 entradas** no page.tsx. O v2 `engines/analysis.ts` guarda histórico de análises em `localforage("algo_audio_analysis_v1")` com hash **SHA-256** do arquivo (fallback SparkMD5), `audioBlob` original, e trim para 3 itens em quota exceeded.

### 2b. Encode/decode hex (as funções exatas, no page.tsx)
```ts
const float32ToHexStream = (samples: Float32Array): string => {
  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(samples.length * 4);
  const view = new DataView(buffer);
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) view.setFloat32(i * 4, samples[i], true); // little-endian
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let hex = '';
  const chunk = 0x8000;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunk)
    for (let j = 0; j < chunk && i+j < bytes.length; j++)
      hex += bytes[i+j].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  return hex;
};
const hexStreamToFloat32 = (hex: string): Float32Array => {
  const len = hex.length / 2;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) bytes[i] = parseInt(hex.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
  return new Float32Array(bytes.buffer);
};
```
Cada float = 8 chars hex. No JSON exportado, porém, `pcmCompactSignalStream` **não vai** — vai só `pcmSequenceStateSeed` (hash FNV-1a dos samples quantizados ×100000) + `pcmSequenceChecksum` (soma ponderada dos |sample|×100000) + `pcmSamplesCount`:

```ts
const computeSeedAndChecksum = (samples) => {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5, checksum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const q = Math.round(samples[i] * 100000);
    hash ^= (q & 0xff); hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
    hash ^= ((q >> 8) & 0xff); hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
    hash ^= ((q >> 16) & 0xff); hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
    checksum += Math.abs(samples[i]) * 100000;
  }
  return { seed: hash >>> 0, checksum: Math.round(checksum) };
};
```
Outras funções de hash do mesmo arquivo: `hashFloatArray`/`hashIntArray` (FNV-1a 32-bit), `hashPeaks`, `mulberry32` (PRNG). Arrays de análise viram **"valores totais"** (somar tudo num número): `midiTotalValue = Σ(m*1000 + s + d + round(v*1000))` etc. — pattern `LayerPattern { midi, chroma, mfcc, env, peaks, root, scale }`.

### 2c. Hex "semântico" (v2 raiz) e assinaturas
`v2/engines/analysis.ts` gera telemetria por milissegundo com hex bruto do PCM int16 (`0x` + `uInt16.toString(16).padStart(4,'0')` por sample) e assinaturas semânticas tipo `"0xBASS_GLIDE_OCTAVE"`, `"0xKICK_SUB_HEAVY_30MS"`, `"0xVOCAL_FORMANT_WOBBLE"` — heurísticas (probabilidade por banda de frequência × RMS), não dados reais de hash. Os JSONs de `json/analise-exemplos.json` carregam `"hex_signature": "0xSIG_8CA2D3C13F98"` / `"0xSIG_D7A7D08B870D"` por faixa.

### 2d. Banco relacional
- `v1/v0.2/prisma/schema.prisma`: **boilerplate** SQLite (User/Post) — nada de áudio; `v0.3/src/lib/db.ts` é o singleton `PrismaClient`. Os diretórios `v1/v1/prisma/`, `db/`, `mini-services/`, `src/lib/` e `examples/websocket/` **estão VAZIOS**; o único `examples/` com código é `v1/v0.2/examples/websocket/{server.ts,frontend.tsx}` (chat socket.io genérico, sem áudio).
- `v2/src/db/schema.ts` (Drizzle/Postgres) **é relevante**: `projects` (kind generated|import|variation, `doc: jsonb`, `embedding: jsonb number[]`, `parentId` p/ linhagem de variação), `segments` (projectId, second, rms, centroid, events jsonb, embedding), `model_state` (jsonb de uma linha — modelo treinado localmente), `dependencies` (registry de pacotes).

## 3) RECONSTRUÇÃO/PLAYBACK — o fluxo JSON→áudio que prova playback

### 3a. v1/v1 page.tsx — pipeline completo com 4 níveis de prioridade
No `scheduleReconSecond`, para cada camada de cada segundo:

```ts
// RECONSTRUÇÃO 100% FIEL por prioridade:
let pcm: Float32Array;
const cached = pcmCacheRef.current.get(`${data.s}:${trackName}`);
if (cached) pcm = cached;                                             // 1. IndexedDB (PCM real)
else if (layer.pcmCompactSignalStream?.length > 0)
  pcm = hexStreamToFloat32(layer.pcmCompactSignalStream);             // 2. hex inline do JSON
else if (layer.pcmSequenceStateSeed && layer.pcmSamplesCount > 0)
  pcm = expandFromSeed(layer.pcmSequenceStateSeed, layer.pcmSamplesCount,
        layer.harmonicExcitationId, layer.phaseAlignmentStateId,
        layer.quantizationNoiseFloorId, layer.pitchHz || layer.hz,
        layer.midiNotes, trackName, layer.sr);                        // 3. síntese da seed
else pcm = synthFromPattern(layer.p, layer.sr, trackName, ...);       // 4. síntese do pattern

const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, pcm.length, layer.sr);   // sampleRate DA CAMADA (browser resample)
buf.copyToChannel(pcm, 0);
const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
src.buffer = buf;
const gain = ctx.createGain();
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.min(1, Math.pow(10, layer.db / 20)), when);
src.connect(gain); gain.connect(analyser);
src.start(when); src.stop(when + 1.0);
```

Scheduling real: `startPlayback` fixa `playStartCtxTimeRef = ctx.currentTime + 0.05`, agenda **todos os segundos futuros** (`base + (i - startSecond)`), pré-carrega 5 s do IndexedDB antes e mais 5 s em background; relógio de progresso via `setInterval(250ms)` com `ctx.currentTime`; `AudioContext` criado com `sampleRate: 44100` fixo (comentário explica bug de pitch-shift com 48 kHz); canvas com RAF único lendo refs; mute por camada no agendamento. Import de JSON valida `timeline[0].camadas[t].p` (pattern numérico).

**O `expandFromSeed` (trecho essencial):** PRNG mulberry32 a partir da seed; timbre por camada (`bass→sawtooth, guitars→triangle, vocals→sine, resto→square`); síntese aditiva de **8 harmônicos** com pesos `[1.0, 0.5, 0.4, 0.33, 0.25, 0.2, 0.16, 0.14]`, anti-aliasing (`hFreq >= sr/2 → break`), envelope ADSR por nota (A 5%, D 10%, S 0.8, R 15%) + envelope global por segundo (A 3%, D 7%, S 75%, R 15%); fase deslocada por `phaseAlignmentStateId*0.001`; percussão/beats = ruído branco + kick sub `sin(2π·60t)·e^(−20t)·0.3`; piso de ruído analógico; LPF one-pole 0.45; crossfade equal-power 256 samples nas bordas; normalização headroom 0.707 (−3 dB). Cada segundo regenera `layer.sr` amostras (~44.100) — a saída é áudio real, porém **aproximado**: o próprio comentário diz "regenerar uma aproximação da onda original que passa pela validação do checksum", e o checksum só bateria se a síntese recriasse exatamente o PCM (não bate).

### 3b. v2 "vector-one" — `src/lib/audio/engine.ts` (o mais completo)
Grafo master: `master(0.8) → WaveShaper tanh (curva k=3.2, oversample 2x) → Compressor(-13/18/4.5/0.003/0.16) → Analyser(2048) → destination`, + delay de feedback (0.27 s, fb 0.34, damp LP 2800/HP 400) e **reverb por convolução com impulso de ruído gerado** (2 s, cauda `pow(1−i/len, 2.2)`), sends por voz. Vozes (todas com `envADSR` com ramps exponenciais):

- `playKick`: osc sine com **envelope de pitch em 2 estágios** `165·tune → 52·tune (55 ms) → 40·tune (140 ms)`, sub tail (50 Hz, +20 ms), **click de ruído HP 1800 Hz por 25 ms**;
- `playSnare`: ruído bandpass 1750 Hz (Q 0.7) + corpo dual `triangle 187 Hz (0.5)/330 Hz (0.22)`;
- `playHat`: ruído HP 7800 Hz, dur 38 ms fechado / 240 ms aberto;
- `playClap`: **4 bursts de ruído bandpass espaçados 9,5 ms** (1250+120·i Hz, Q 1.6), último mais alto e longo;
- `playBass` (808): sub sine com **pitch snap** `hz*2 → hz em 45 ms` + sawtooth mid LP 480 Hz, ambos num WaveShaper de drive;
- `playLead` supersaw (3 saws detune ±9), `playPad` (2 saws + triangle, LP com LFO 0.28 Hz ±520), `playKeys` (sine + triangle 2.01x, tremolo 4.2 Hz), `playBell` (parciais inarmônicos 1/2.76/5.4), `playArp` (square + saw 2x, LP env), `playFlute` (sine + ruído bandpass 2f0 Q6, vibrato 5.2 Hz→frequência).

**Transport (scheduler real com look-ahead):**
```ts
start(doc, { startStep, swing }) {
  this.stepDur = 60 / doc.bpm / 4;            // 16th
  this.totalSteps = doc.bars * 16;
  this.startedAt = c.currentTime + 0.06;
  const swingOffset = s => (s % 2 === 1 ? this.swingAmt * this.stepDur * 0.6 : 0);
  const tick = () => {
    while (this.nextStepTime < ctx.currentTime + 0.14) {   // look-ahead 140 ms
      const lane = this.step % 16;
      if (doc.drums.kick[lane])  scheduleDrum("kick",  t, 0.95);
      if (doc.drums.hat[lane])   scheduleDrum("hat",   t, this.step % 4 === 2 ? 0.9 : 0.68);
      for (const n of doc.notes) if (n.step % totalSteps === s)
        voiceFn(n.voice)(t, n.pitch, n.dur * this.stepDur, n.vel);
      this.nextStepTime += this.stepDur;
    }
  };
  this.timer = setInterval(tick, 28);
}
```

**Render offline (prova de áudio sem servidor):** `renderToBuffer(doc)` usa `OfflineAudioContext(2, ceil(dur*44100), 44100)` com espelho do grafo (gain 0.85 → shaper k=5.5 → compressor), agenda cada step com `osc_`/`nz` espelhando as vozes, `offline.startRendering()` → **WAV 16-bit** (`bufferToWavBlob` escreve RIFF/fmt/data manualmente no DataView) ou **MP3 128 kbps via lamejs** (`Mp3Encoder(2, sr, 128)`, blocos de 1152, encodeBuffer+flush).

### 3c. Playback Tone.js — `ts/musicEngine.ts`
`MusicEngine` com `Tone.Transport`: `createSynth` por tipo (kick = `MembraneSynth{pitchDecay:0.05, octaves:10, sine, env 0.001/0.35/0/0.1}`; **808 = `MembraneSynth{pitchDecay:0.3, octaves:4, decay 0.8, sustain 0.1, release 0.5}`**; hihat = `MetalSynth{harmonicity 5.1, modulationIndex 40, resonance 5000}`; bass = `MonoSynth saw + filterEnvelope baseFrequency 100`), cadeia por voz `synth → Filter (low/band/highpass por freqRange) → Panner → Compressor(-30/10) → Limiter(-8) → Gain(0.4) → Analyser`. Loops individuais `Tone.Loop` com `stepDuration = 60/bpm/4`; `triggerNote` escolhe nota pela teoria do gênero (ex. 808 toca a fundamental do acorde uma oitava abaixo: `chord808[0].replace('3','1')`).

## 4) GERAÇÃO — síntese por código com constantes

### 4a. Doc 16 (`16-geracao-musica-sintetica.md`) — `tools/gerar-musica.cjs`, síntese PCM pura
Constantes: `SR=48000, BPM=166.7 (detectado por autocorrelação), BEAT=0.36 s, BAR=1.44 s, TOTAL=192.7 s`. Escala Em com frequências tabeladas (E1 20.60 Hz → E5 329.63 Hz). Instrumentos sample-accurate:

- **Kick 808**: envelope de pitch exponencial `100·e^(−25t) + 45 Hz` nos primeiros 80 ms, depois 45 Hz fixo; click inicial 20 ms @1500 Hz; amp `e^(−5t)`.
- Snare: ruído + corpo 200 Hz, `e^(−25t)`; Hi-hat: ruído branco decay 60× (fechado) / 15× (aberto); **Pad: saw = soma de 6 harmônicos com peso 1/n, ADSR attack 0.5 s**; Lead: square + vibrato 5 Hz, attack 20 ms; Bass: sine fundamental + sub (f/2), attack 10 ms.
- **Vocal sintético por formantes** (`vocalFormant`): vogais com F1/F2/F3 tabelados — `A: 730/1090/2440, E: 530/1840/2480, I: 270/2290/3010, O: 570/840/2410, U: 300/870/2240, M: 250/1000/2000`; sílabas com duração BEAT×1/2, pitch E4–E5, vibrato 5 Hz. Estrutura 112 bars (intro 14, A 39, break 8, B 49, outro 19) + 2,7 s silêncio; progressão Em→G→Am→Bm (4 bars cada). Validação real: RMS -19.44 dB, peak -0.91 dB, espectrogramas PNG comparados ao original.

### 4b. `v2/src/lib/audio/generator.ts` (Aurora Composer) — composição simbólica
**48 escalas** (maiores/modos, harmônicas, pentatônicas, blues, simétricas, hijaz, húngara, persiana, japonesas insen/iwato/kumoi, prometheus, tritone…). **9 presets de estilo** com lanes de bateria exatas, ex.:
```
trap:  bpm 88-100, scales [pent_minor, harmonic_minor, blues_min, phrygian, minor], lead pluck,
       register [60,84], intensity 0.72, kick [0,6,10], snare [4,12],
       hat [0,1,2,3,5,6,8,9,10,12,13,14,15], clap [4,12], prog [0,0,5,3], swing 0.12,
       groove main [[0,1],[3,1],[6,2],[10,1],[14,1]]
drill: bpm 138-146, kick [0,3,6,11,14], swing 0.18, lead bell
lofi:  bpm 72-80, kick [0,10], swing 0.34, lead keys …
```
`parsePrompt` (pt/en) extrai BPM literal, escala por regex ("dorian", "blues", "hijaz"…), tônica por token `[a-g][#b]`, mood; **PRNG seedrandom determinístico** (`seedrandom(prompt#salt)`) — mesmo prompt = mesma música. Regras estruturais: **bass locked to kick** (`drums.kick[s]===1 → note {pitch: 24+chordPc, vel:0.94, dur:2, voice:"bass"}`), melodia do template rítmico do estilo (fill no 4º compasso), acordes nos accents, resolução à fundamental no fim do compasso, pads root+3ª (dur 8, vel 0.32). `nextPitch` = **Markov de 1ª ordem** sobre `model.noteBigram` com viés de passos próximos (±3 semitons +0.5). `composeLong` encadeia seções de 2 bars com `DRIFT_CYCLE [0.16,0.28,0.42,0.22,0.5,0.3]` e `ENERGY_CYCLE [0.84,1.0,1.08,0.95,1.05,0.9]` (build/drop); `vary()` faz **drift diatônico** (`scaleStepWalk` ±1/±2) preservando groove/bass.

### 4c. `v2/engines/generator/*.ts` — compileXXX por gênero (11 estilos)
`engines/generator/generator.ts` define tipos de layer (KICK/808/REESE_BASS/PAD/FM_BELL/ACID_303/KARPLUS_STRING…), zustand TrackState com intensity/density/chaos/hue por layer e histórico; `getLayersByStyle` seleciona o preset (trap tem 15 layers: 2 kicks, 2×808 — SUB_DROP + REESE_BASS —, snare+rimshot, hat+glitch, chords duplos, leads duplos, choir pad, flutes/brass). `engines/generator/trap.ts` (`compileTrap`) é síntese ** OfflineAudioContext 44100 estéreo, sample-accurate**: BPM→`samplesPerStep = SR/(BPM/60)/4`; seed **xorshift32** derivada do id (`Math.imul(seed ^ char, 0x5bd1e995)`, `seed ^= version*99991`); tônica `36 + floor(hue*12)`; escala frígia `[0,1,3,5,7,8,10]` que vira dórica se `hue>0.7`; patterns por família (kick `p[0]=1, p[10]=0.9, p[6]/p[14] aleatórios`; snare half-time `p[8]`; hats pares + rolls por chaos); melodias por graus com saltos. Env helpers multiplicativos por sample (`val *= decay`).

### 4d. Outros
- `ts/instruments.ts`: presets ADSR numéricos (bass saw LP 800 Hz Q5; subbass sine LP 120; pad saw attack 0.3 reverb 0.5; kick `{source:'synth', pitch:60, pitchDecay:0.05, ADSR 0.001/0.35/0/0.1}`) + `layerInstruments` (min attack, max decay/release, média de sustain).
- `ts/theory.ts`: `createRng(seed)` = **LCG determinístico** `(s*1103515245+12345) & 0x7fffffff`; `midiToFreq = 440·2^((m−69)/12)`; 13 escalas; acordes (maj…dom9); consonância por intervalo.
- `ts/rhythm.ts`: grooves (reggaeton dembow accents [0,3,6,9,12] swing 60 ms; breakbeat offsets [0,30,0,20]…), `applySwing` (+50 ms nos steps ímpares), `humanizeTiming/Velocity`, `bpmToStepDurationMs`.
- `v2/lib/audio-engine.ts`: **AudioWorklet** real (`AdvancedVoiceProcessor`) — ducking/gate por envelope follower com sidechain, soft-knee expander `(1-reduction) + reduction·(env/threshold)²`; EQ de 9 bandas padrão "nc4" (115 Hz 0, 250 Hz **−9**, 450 Hz +2, 7500 −3, 12870 +5) + compressor makeup 4.5 dB (`v2/engines/mixer.ts` adiciona 9-band "nc4": 86 Hz +3, 159 Hz **−7**, 6360 −9, shelf 16k +12, threshold −28 ratio 8).

## 5) PADRÕES POR GÊNERO — mineração e geração de JSON similar

- **Mineração de referência**: `analyser.mjs` processa um diretório inteiro de WAVs e produz `analise-master.json` consolidado (exatamente o que está em `json/`); `v2/src/app/api/analyze/route.ts` ingere o timeline validado, salva segments no Postgres, converte via `timelineToProject` num **"template da IA"** e **treina o modelo local** (`trainOnProject` → bigramas de notas, histogramas de bateria 16-step, centróide de embedding, afinidade de escala, histograma de BPM); `api/similar` retorna projetos próximos por **cosine similarity** dos embeddings de 32 dims.
- **Mineração de áudio→groove**: `timelineToProject` aprende o groove real por contagem de onsets por step (`counts.kick[s]/segundos > 0.22 → 1`), bass da tônica a cada 2 bars, pads a cada 4 — garantindo downbeat (`if (!groove.kick.includes(1)) groove.kick[0]=1`).
- **Condicionamento ao modelo**: `generateDrums` adota steps dominantes do histograma treinado (`model.drumHistogram.kick[s] > 0.55` após `trainedOn>=3`); `nextPitch` usa os bigramas aprendidos; sem modelo, usa presets profissionais.
- **Estilos por camadas** (v2 raiz): 11 `getXXXLayers` com fórmula `makeLayer(tipos, intensity, density, chaos)` — ex. drill/hiphop/lofi/ambient/hyperpop/rude_trap/edm/pop/house/techno/trap — e orquestração por LLM (`aiManipulator.ts` com Gemini `@google/genai`, schema de actions ADD/UPDATE/REMOVE sobre ~40 tipos de layer + BPM/duração; "você não compõe as notas, só seta as variáveis").
- **Theory por gênero** (ts/): `GENRE_CONFIG` (trap 130–170 minor, progressões [1,6,4,5]; drill 140–150; reggaeton dembow; jazz swing…) e `COMMON_PROGRESSIONS` com graus romanos, inversões, voice leading (maxLeap 7), voicings drop2/drop3, arpejos up/down/upDown/random, substituições (relativa/paralela/**tritônica** V→bII) e modulação.
- **Pattern generators hardcoded** (ts/rhythm.ts, musicEngine.ts): kick trap `p[0,4,8,12]` + variações [3,7,10,14] (drill slide), hats trap 8ths/16ths com roll no fim do bar ([12..15]), reggaeton `p[6]` snare, etc.

## 6) VEREDITO — pipeline real vs simulado

**REAL (gera/toca som de fato):**
1. **`v2/src/lib/audio/*`** — pipeline completo fechado: análise FFT/YIN → timeline JSON Zod → embedding 32-d → geração simbólica com seedrandom/Markov → síntese Web Audio (osciladores, ruído, filtros, envelopes) → **render OfflineAudioContext → WAV/MP3 lamejs**. Melhor evidência: `engine.ts renderToBuffer/renderToMp3/bufferToWavBlob` + `Transport` com look-ahead.
2. **`v1/v1/page.tsx`** — análise Meyda/YIN real, stems por biquad, PCM real no IndexedDB e playback agendado por `AudioBufferSourceNode` (prioridades 1–2 são 100% fiéis: PCM do IndexedDB e hex inline).
3. **`mjs/analyser.mjs` + `ffmpeg.mjs`** — ingestão Node real (ffmpeg binário, f32le, STFT), comprovada pelos JSONs de `json/` (mas com bugs de BPM por falta de fold/limiar).
4. **`ts/musicEngine.ts`** — Tone.js toca de verdade (MembraneSynth/MetalSynth/NoiseSynth + Transport).
5. **`v2/engines/generator/*.ts` (compileXXX)** — síntese PCM sample-accurate em OfflineAudioContext com PRNG xorshift semeado; **`v2/lib/audio-engine.ts`** AudioWorklet real de ducking; **`engines/mixer.ts`** cadeia EQ/compressor aplicável a nós reais.
6. **Docs 15/16** — relatam execução real (`tools/*.cjs`) com artefatos (WAVs de 18,5 MB, espectrogramas, métricas LUFS/correlação); o algoritmo HPSS-by-moving-average e o kick 808 por envelope de pitch são reprodutíveis a partir do código citado.

**SIMULADO/PARCIAL (não entrega o que promete):**
- **`expandFromSeed`/`computeSeedAndChecksum` (v1)** — a "reconstrução pela seed" é síntese aditiva aproximada; o checksum nunca valida de verdade (o comentário admite "aproximação"); os ~200 campos `*Id/*Hash` por segundo são em grande parte **constantes ou XORs decorativos** (`spectralRoughnessId: 0`, `attackTimeId: 10`, `yinPitchHash: pcm32Hash ^ 0x34567`) — metadados para IA mais cosméticos que funcionais.
- **`v2/engines/analysis.ts` (telemetria ms)** — as "assinaturas hex semânticas" (`0xKICK_SUB_HEAVY_30MS`) e probabilidades de bus são heurísticas de ZCR×RMS, não DSP sério; pitch por ZCR é grosseiro.
- **Classificação de instrumentos (v1)** — regra honesta, mas com IDs numéricos estilo GM fingindo ser saída de ML (YAMNet foi removido).
- **`prisma/`, `db/`, `mini-services/`, `src/lib/` de `v1/v1`** — diretórios **vazios** (scaffolding); schema Prisma de v0.2 é boilerplate User/Post; `examples/websocket` é chat socket.io sem áudio.
- **`mjs/dsp.mjs`** — FFT iterativa inacabada (throw no meio); `json/package.json` (1,7 MB) e `analise-master.json` são dumps de dados, não configuração.

**Resumo dos .md grandes (1–2 linhas cada):** os ~60 .md na raiz são pesquisa/planilhamento conceitual (sem código executável): `ANALISE-ESPECTRAL`, `SINTESE-TIPOS-SOM` e `SINTESE-REALISTA` = teoria de DSP/síntese; `STEM-SEPARATION`, `EXTRACAO-REFERENCIAS-REAIS` = pipelines de decomposição; `TYPE-BEATS-POR-GENERO`, `MIXING-MASTERING-POR-GENERO`, `CAMADAS-COMPLEXAS`, `ASSEMBLAGEM-PADROES`, `MONTAGEM-INTELIGENTE`, `ORGANIZACAO-SAMPLES` = receitas por gênero/arranjo; `PIPELINE-TREINAMENTO`, `MACHINE-TREINAMENTO-COMPLETA`, `DATASETS-E-MODELOS`, `FORMATOS-DADOS-PREV processados` = treinamento/datasets; `CONCORRENCES-*`, `FL-STUDIO-ANALISE`, `COMO-CONCORRENCES-ORGANIZAM` = benchmarking de concorrentes; `ARQUITETURA-OFFLINE-COMPLETA`, `INFRAESTRUTURA-AUDIO-AI`, `COMPRESSAO-MODELOS`, `MODELO-OFFLINE-COMPACTO`, `APPS-OFFLINE-ANALISE` = arquitetura offline; `SISTEMA-QUALIDADE-COMPLETO`, `QUALIDADE-AUDIO-ESPECIFICACOES`, `O-QUE-FALTA`, `PLANO-TECNICO-MASTER`, `PLANO-DE-ACAO` = qualidade/roadmap; `md/readme.md` = consolidação técnica ("Motor de Áudio por IA"); `README.txt` = README da biblioteca Rubber Band (time-stretch de terceiros); `pacotes.txt` = lista de pacotes (@xenova/transformers, aubiojs, meyda…).

# t3code design system extraction

stack: react + vite + tailwind v4 + base ui primitives + cva variants + `data-slot` attributes. single global stylesheet `apps/web/src/index.css` (2478 lines); everything else is tailwind classes in components. governance doc: `docs/internals/web-ui.md` ("pick a variant, do not restyle with className", enforced by `shadcn/no-restyle` lint per `AGENTS.md`).

## 1. layout system

- two-pane shell: resizable offcanvas sidebar + chat canvas. sidebar width tokens: default 256px (`16*16`), min 208px (`13*16`), main content min width 640px (`40*16`), width persisted to localStorage (`apps/web/src/components/threadSidebarWidth.ts`, `AppSidebarLayout.tsx:340-415`). double-click rail resets width (`SidebarRail onDoubleClick`).
- right panel: inline under 980px viewport, popover above (`RIGHT_PANEL_INLINE_LAYOUT_MEDIA_QUERY = "(max-width: 980px)"`, `apps/web/src/rightPanelLayout.ts`); sheet width `w-[min(42vw,28rem)]` (`RightPanelSheet.tsx:25`).
- chrome geometry variables (`index.css:101-137`): `--control-radius: 0.5rem`, `--sidebar-content-inset: 0.5rem`, `--sidebar-control-gap: 0.5rem`, `--sidebar-row-content-inset: 0.625rem`, `--command-shell-inset: 0.5rem`, `--floating-content-inset: 0.75rem`, `--workspace-topbar-height: 52px` (min 40px in wco mode), `--workspace-gutter: 0.75rem` (1.25rem at sm), `--chat-content-max-width: 46rem` (72rem wide, 100% full), `--thread-details-panel-width: 17.5rem`.
- chat lane: `.chat-content-lane { margin-inline auto; max-width var(--chat-content-max-width) }` with `--chat-lane-inset-start/end` gutters; composer lane padding 0.75rem mobile, 3rem at >=640px (`index.css:930-935, 2441-2477`).
- frameless-window integration: `--workspace-controls-*` derive from `env(titlebar-area-*)` (window controls overlay, `index.css:152-163`), `.drag-region` with `-webkit-app-region: drag` + child reset for electron 44 (`index.css:1746-1767`), windows resize inset `--desktop-window-right-resize-inset: 6px` (`index.css:1676-1678`).
- density: `data-density="touch"` attributes + `in-data-[density=touch]` variants on menu items; every size has an `sm:` desktop-compacted twin (button default `h-9 sm:h-8`, compact `h-7`, menu item `min-h-8 sm:min-h-7`) — a two-tier density system baked into each component, not a global switch (`components/ui/button.tsx`, `menu.tsx:88`).
- scrollbars: 6px lane (`--app-scrollbar-width: 6px`), transparent track, `rgb(217 217 217)` light / `rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` dark thumb, 3px radius (`index.css:89-96, 1770-1785`).

## 2. color tokens

system: semantic css variables mapped to tailwind theme via `@theme inline` (`index.css:174-336`); themes override at `html[data-theme-id]` via `--app-theme-*` roles (`index.css:1256-1321`). contrast roles computed live with `color-mix` against surface (`--contrast-foreground`, `--contrast-border`, etc., `index.css:1531-1643`) so an appearance-contrast boost setting re-derives every role.

default light (`packages/shared/src/themePalettes.ts:118-180`, verbatim hex):
- canvas/chrome/toolbar `#fcfcfc`, surface/overlay `#ffffff`, text `#27272a`, text-muted `#71717b`, border `#e4e4e7`, input `#d4d4d8`, accent + focus + message-action `#1b4ed8`, accent-fg `#ffffff`, secondary/muted `#fafafa`, error `#fb2c36` (fg `#c10007`, surface `#fcebec`), warning `#fe9a00` (fg `#bb4d00`, surface `#fcf4e8`), update `#1b4ed8`/surface `#e0e6f7`, success inherits tailwind emerald, code `#ffffff`, sidebar `#fafafa`, rows hover `#fcfcfc`/active+selected `#ffffff`, terminal bg `#fcfcfc`, cursor `#26384e`, selection `#d0d6dd`.

default dark (`themePalettes.ts:182-244`):
- canvas/toolbar/sidebar `#0a0a0a`, surface/code `#111111`, hover control `#141414`, text `#f5f5f5`, text-muted `#818181`, border `#191919`, input `#1e1e1e`, accent + focus + message-action `#346bf1`, message-action-hover `#3061d9`, error `#fb414a` (fg `#ff6467`, surface `#301214`), warning `#fe9a00` (fg `#ffb900`, surface `#312108`), update-fg `#51a2ff`/surface `#121b34`, sidebar-fg `#f1f3f7`, row hover `#131313`, active `#1a1b1b`, terminal cursor `#b4cbff`, selection `#343a47`.

raw fallback palette in `:root` (`index.css:1091-1199`): light background `--color-zinc-25` (oklch 99.2%), primary `oklch(0.488 0.217 264)`; dark background `--color-neutral-950`, primary `oklch(0.571 0.21 264)`, borders as `--alpha(var(--color-white) / 6%)`, accent hover `white/4%` — dark mode principle stated in a comment: "keep controls and floating surfaces close to the neutral-black canvas. borders and hover states provide separation without milky gray fills."

5 built-in palettes (t3-chat, grove, ocean, ember, iris) in oklch, including stage-art gradient tokens (`index.css:656-895`, `themePalettes.ts:246+`). diff scheme switchable to blue-orange via `:root[data-diff-color-scheme="blue-orange"]` (`index.css:2203-2216`).

grain: procedural svg fractal-noise tile, 256px, opacity 0.035, baked per-surface not as overlay (`index.css:1680-1704`); t3-chat theme gets 128px tile at alpha 7/255.

## 3. typography

- sans stack: `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` — deliberately no webfont (`index.css:169`); mono: `"SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace` with comment that `ui-monospace` aliases to proportional font on some engines (`appearanceFonts.ts:13-19`, `index.css:170-171`).
- three independent sizes, user-configurable 12-20 / 12-20 / 10-18px, defaults 16 (interface, drives root font-size so all rem scales), 14 (prompt, absolute px), 13 (code/diffs, absolute px) (`packages/contracts/src/settings.ts:121-143`, `appearanceFonts.ts:77-106`). prompt floor enforced at 16px on touch to defeat ios zoom (`--font-size-prompt-touch`, `index.css:132`). separate `--font-composer` token; optional antialiased smoothing toggle.
- extended tailwind micro scale (`index.css:180-187`): `text-2xs` 11px, `text-3xs` 10px, `text-4xs` 8px, `text-5xs` 7px, with computed line-heights, registered in tailwind-merge.
- markdown scale (`index.css:1812-1844`): h1 1.25rem, h2 1.125rem, h3 1rem, h4-h6 0.875rem, all weight 600, line-height 1.3; tables 0.75rem with uppercase-ish 600 headers and 24rem cell clamp with expand toggle (`index.css:2123-2178`).
- tabular figures: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on ordered-list markers (`index.css:1866-1868`) and `font-mono tabular-nums` on mono inputs (`input.tsx:68`); kbd chips use font-sans 12px (`kbd.tsx`).
- custom font features: canvas-metric font availability probing, monospace detection by advance-width tolerance 0.01, local-font permission query (`appearanceFonts.ts:130-332`).

## 4. motion + micro interactions

- named easing token: `--ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` for surfaces that slide/pop (`index.css:192`); popups use base-ui `data-starting-style/data-ending-style` with `scale-98 + opacity-0`, 200ms `ease-in-out` for dialogs (`dialog-styles.ts:8`), 150ms `ease-out` on find bar, toast transform `.5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` (`toast.tsx:563`).
- press physics: buttons `scale-[0.97]` on `:active` with `will-change-[scale]` + inset highlight `0 1px white/16%` resting, `0 1px black/8%` pressed (`button.tsx:9, 41`); slider thumb hover `scale(1.08)`, active `scale(0.94)`, 120ms ease (`index.css:978-1020`).
- panel animations are a user setting 0-400ms, default 0 — no animation by default on desktop (`packages/contracts/src/settings.ts:110-119`, `panelAnimations.ts:30-38`); double-rAF suppression prevents crossfade on route change.
- duty-cycled streaming indicators (the signature perf discipline): `skeleton` 2.4s, `status-pulse` 2s, `status-ping` 2s, all using `steps()` so compositor draws ~6-8 discrete frames per cycle instead of vsync (`index.css:287-335`); shine sweep on running tools `live-tool-shine 2.2s steps(30)` (`index.css:525-552`); everything gated on `--visible-animation-state` so offscreen animations pause, and `motion-safe:`/`prefers-reduced-motion` overrides everywhere.
- streaming text: `@starting-style` opacity fade 600ms ease-out on markdown blocks, gated on `data-streaming` so finished threads never replay (`index.css:2101-2116`).
- fake-but-honest progress: preview loading bar animates `scaleX(0.04 -> 0.9)` over 5.3s `cubic-bezier(0.1,0.5,0.2,1)`, 150ms ease-out fade with 220ms delay (`index.css:2288-2321`).
- focus: global 2px ring, `outline-offset: -2px` everywhere so outlines survive clipped edges (`index.css:691-696`), `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-inset ring-offset-1`; 44px touch hit targets via `pointer-coarse:after:min-h-11` (`button.tsx`, `badge.tsx`).
- mobile composer morph uses native view transitions with a 35%-65% crossfade keyframe pair (`index.css:19-87`); theme switches kill all transitions via `.no-transitions` (`index.css:1082-1089`).

- composer: nested glass shell — `ComposerSurface.Shell` carries `--chat-composer-glass-surface` + backdrop-blur 12/16px at 80% opacity with a `clip-path: shape()` scooped bottom corners for the context strip (22px radius, `--chat-composer-drawer-inset: 1.375rem`), `Host` adds `shadow-composer` = `0 12px 28px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%)` (dark `0 14px 32px -18px / 75%`), outline `rgb(0 0 0 / 8%)` light / `white 5%` dark, seam gradients for attached banners (`ComposerSurface.tsx`, `index.css:195-218`); ultrathink mode swaps in an animated 7-color spectrum border frame (`index.css:2245-2286`, `composerProviderState.tsx:155-161`).

- dialogs: `dialog-glass` blur 12px + shadow `0 24px 64px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 65%)` (dark adds `inset 0 1px white/4%` + `0 24px 72px -20px / 90%`), backdrop = background at 60% + blur 4px, nested-dialog stacking via `--nested-dialogs` (each level translates -1.25rem, scales -0.1, dims -0.1) (`index.css:399-426`, `dialog-styles.ts`).
- toasts: two managers (global + thread-anchored), corner dismiss orb `size-6 rounded-full bg-popover/92 backdrop-blur-sm`, expandable error bodies with `line-clamp-4` clamp at 180+ chars, copy-error action, stacked vs inline action layouts (`toast.tsx`).
- chips: context chip sized entirely in em (`h-[1.41em] rounded-[0.5em] text-[0.86em]`) so it scales inside text, 18 kind accents at `oklch(0.62 0.16 h)` with border `color-mix(accent 34%, border)`, bg accent/11%, hover 17%, unresolved = dashed, invalid = destructive (`ContextChip.tsx`).
- badges: sizes control/default/lg/sm at h-7/5.5/6.5/5, tone variants info/success/warning/error at `bg-x/8 text-x-foreground` (dark /16), label variant color-mixed from a `--label` var (`badge.tsx`).
- alerts: rounded-xl px-3.5 py-3, variants error/info/success/warning with `border-x/32 bg-x-surface` pattern; glass surface option; compact sidebar alert 11px (`alert.tsx`).
- empty states: slot-based (empty-header/media/title/description/content), sizes compact (min-h-64 p-6), default, hero (title 2xl/3xl); icon variant renders two rotated stacked cards at -10/+10deg scale-84 (`empty.tsx`).
- tabs: no tabs primitive by doctrine — semantic rows; per docs "raw elements are right when... tabs" (`docs/internals/web-ui.md`); panel tabs get a hover-reveal close button swapping icon for x (`panel-tab-close-button.tsx`).
- sidebar rows: `hover:bg-sidebar-row-hover`, `active:bg-sidebar-row-active`, `data-[active=true]:bg-sidebar-row-selected font-medium`, heights h-7 rounded-lg, icons colored `--sidebar-icon-color` at 60% mix (`ui/sidebar.tsx:687-701`, `index.css:104-108`).
- status dots: `size-2` dot + ping ring, connected success / connecting warning + 2000ms ping / error destructive (`ConnectionStatusDot.tsx`).
- kbd: h-5 min-w-5 rounded bg-muted px-1 text-xs font-medium (`kbd.tsx`).

## 7. windows 11 rival: copy / avoid

copy:
1. the duty-cycled animation discipline — `steps()` keyframes for skeleton/ping/pulse, paused offscreen via `--visible-animation-state`, panel animation duration as a user setting defaulting to 0 (`index.css:287-335`, `AGENTS.md` taste: "no continuously repainting animations"). on high-refresh windows laptops this is the difference between smooth and hot.
2. contrast-role pipeline: compute every text/border role with `color-mix` against its actual surface so a single contrast-boost slider re-derives the whole palette with zero component changes (`index.css:1531-1643`). solves win11 light/dark theme chaos permanently.
3. the documented z-index ladder with a named variable per layer and a comment as contract (`index.css:113-116`) — modals 50, pickers 130, tooltips 140, toasts 9999-minus-stack-index.
4. inset-highlight button physics (resting `inset 0 1px white/16%`, pressed `black/8%`, scale 0.97, shadow removed while pressed) + 2px inset focus rings — reads as physical on windows where flat tailwind buttons read dead (`button.tsx:9,41`, `index.css:691-696`).
5. em-sized inline chips and the 2xs/3xs/4xs micro-type scale registered into tailwind-merge — dense diagnostics surfaces without breaking prose (`ContextChip.tsx:9`, `index.css:180-187`).

avoid:
1. no webfonts for app chrome — the stack is pure system fonts (`Segoe UI` first on windows); shipping a brand webfont into a dev tool adds load time and fights os text rendering. (their marketing site is a different story.)
2. do not paint dark-mode separation with gray fills — their stated rule is neutral-black canvas + borders + white-alpha hovers (`index.css:1163-1165`); milky `#1e1e1e` cards everywhere is the classic win11 dark-mode failure.
3. do not build a tabs primitive "because apps have tabs" — their doctrine is variants on shared primitives and semantic rows for anything whose geometry differs (`docs/internals/web-ui.md`); premature abstractions ossify.
4. do not restyle primitives at call sites — `shadcn/no-restyle` lint; a rival that lets every feature hand-tune `className` on the shared button ends up with 40 subtly different controls.
5. do not put grain/blur overlays on the root element — they measured the compositor cost and moved the grain into each surface's own background (`index.css:1680-1686` comment); a fixed full-viewport backdrop-filter overlay pegs the gpu on any animation.

# zcode design system extraction report

product character (from `DESIGN.md`): "calm, dense, operational" desktop-first ai workspace. density over decoration; hierarchy via text weight/color before borders; brand color never as page fill.

## 1. layout system

- shell is a hand-rolled css-variable split, not react-resizable-panels, for the outermost divide: sidebar width is written to `--workspace-sidebar-panel-width` on the shell element so native window resizes never re-render react (`packages/ui/src/app-shell/WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:142, 1146-1151, 2268`).
- sidebar: default 264px, min 264px, max 50% of container, keyboard resize step 16px, persisted to `localStorage["zcode:workspace-shell:sidebar-width-px"]` (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:125-133, 165-170, 179-214`). collapse transition `duration-200 ease-out transition-[width,opacity]`, drag disables width transition via `data-[workspace-sidebar-resizing=true]` (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:2268`).
- side pane: min 240px, max 65%, collapsed 0 (`app-shell/animatedSidePanePanelModel.ts:57-75`); conversation column min 35%, side-pane-open default 52% (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:2377-2405`); terminal panel min height 140px (`app-shell/AnimatedTerminalPanel.tsx:107-108`).
- frames: independent conversation / terminal / side-pane frames each own bg+border with 4px resizable gaps; panel radius per platform: windows 6px, mac 12px (tahoe 26+) else 6px, linux 12px; resize-handle inset = radius + 6px (windows) or + 4px (`app-shell/workspaceShellWindowChrome.ts:15-31`). linux window shell radius 16px around 12px panels with 4px outer inset (`DESIGN.md` "Color Usage Rules").
- resize handles: 4px hit area (`w-1`/`h-1`), 2px indicator line (`w-0.5`/`h-0.5`) colored `foreground-subtlest/50` on web, `--color-resize-handle` (sky-500 light / sky-400 dark) on desktop; line inset by panel radius, rounded ends, opacity fade on hover/focus/drag (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:2328-2334`, `AnimatedTerminalPanel.tsx:95`).
- density: 4px base unit; rhythm 4/8/12/16/20-24px; flex text needs `min-w-0`, scroll regions need `min-h-0` (`DESIGN.md` spacing). content min width 320px (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:2353`). control heights h-5/h-6/h-7/h-8; inputs h-7 default, h-9 for plain form fields in `DESIGN.md`; icons size-2.5 to size-6, baseline size-4.

## 3. typography

- sans: tailwind default stack (font-sans); mono defined with explicit cjk fix: `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", "Microsoft YaHei UI", ...` (`styles.css:146-148`).
- scalable ui scale driven by one variable `--ui-font-size` default 14px; never mutate html font-size (`styles.css:76`, `DESIGN.md`): xl=+4 (18), lg=+2 (16), base=14, caption=13, sm=12, xs=10, 2xs=9 (restricted to chart axis furniture), settings-title 24/30. `text-mobile-input-safe` fixed 16px for ios zoom floor (`styles.css:166`).
- weight ladder: h3-h4 semibold, h5 medium, h6 normal sharing base size; labels `font-medium`; heavy weights discouraged (`DESIGN.md`).
- `tabular-nums` used on all counters/timers/token counts, usually paired with `font-mono text-ui-xs` (`BackgroundTaskElapsedLabel.tsx:68`, `WorkflowRunSpineParts.tsx:284,326`).
- lucide icons get tinted-opacity treatment (subtle 60%, subtlest 40% light / 30% dark) via custom plugin `lucide-colors.mjs` and `--lucide-subtlest-opacity` (`styles.css:276,449,613`).

## 4. motion and micro-interactions

- vocabulary: fast and low-drama; overlays use fade+zoom-95+directional slide-2 (8px) via tw-animate-css (`dialog.tsx:69`, `dropdown-menu.tsx:45`, `popover.tsx:30`, `tooltip.tsx:64`).
- duration histogram across ui package: 150ms (21x) and 200ms (22x) dominate, then 100ms overlays, 300ms collapsible, 500ms rare. easing: ease-out (42x) and ease-in-out (19x).
- hover/press: buttons only transition colors (`transition-colors`, perf comment in `button.tsx:7-10`); hover = bg swap `bg-primary/80`, `bg-hover`, `bg-menu-hover`; press in workflow pills = `scale(0.985)` (`styles.css` `.wf-pill-open:active`); segmented reveal on hover (status mark scales out 0.6, arrow scales in, 160/200ms).
- focus: global reset of outline/box-shadow (`styles.css:126-139`); per-component rings like `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-input-border-focused/30` (`checkbox.tsx:15`, `switch.tsx:18`); ring radius tokens (`--color-ring` 40% mix for tile focus, `styles.css:1626`).
- streaming states: token-stream fade-in `zcode-stream-text-in 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)` with per-token delay var; list-marker fade variant; tool rows and chat loading same 900ms entry (`styles.css:1055-1099`); collapsible close 300ms ease-in-out; running tool icon `animate-pulse`, spinner `animate-spin size-4`; indeterminate tool progress sweep 1.2s ease-in-out infinite (`styles.css:964-973`); "running lamp" heartbeat 1.6s scale 1.12 + expanding ring (`wf-beat`); highspeed composer activation is a phased border dissolve: 1040ms `cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)` border transition, particle layer opacity 444ms, then stable glow = 4 stacked box-shadows (`highspeed-activation.css:33-100`).
- toast: enter/exit 200ms `cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1)`, 3s auto-dismiss, directional entry per position (top-right slides from `translate-x-[calc(100%+1rem)]`) (`toast.tsx:70-71, 315-334`).
- reduced-motion: every custom animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` zeroing block (styles.css throughout); document-hidden pauses all animation to fix memory leak (`styles.css:91-96`).

## 5. z-index and layering

in-component tailwind tiers only; no z-index css variables, no stylesheet z rules (grep of styles.css returns none). measured usage histogram: z-10 (56), z-20 (25), z-50 (20), z-30 (14), z-40 (8), z-[60] (7), z-[1] (7), z-0/z-1/z-2, then arbitraries z-[19], z-[61], z-[100], z-[9998], z-[9999] (4).

- discipline: passive in-panel stacking uses z-10..z-30 (resize handles z-10, sticky headers z-20, window controls z-30, drag overlays z-40 with `bg-accent/55 backdrop-blur-sm` or `bg-background/72` scrims).
- interactive overlays (radix dropdown/context/select/popover content) all sit at `z-[60]` — above dialog/modal `z-50` and above tooltips at `z-50`, enforcing the design rule "interactive overlays must render above passive tooltips" (`dropdown-menu.tsx:45`, `context-menu.tsx:28`, `select.tsx:106`, `popover.tsx:30`, `dialog.tsx:40,69`, `tooltip.tsx:64`).
- toasts own the top of the world at `z-[9999]`, portal-rendered to `#zcode-toast-host`, fixed positions `top-16` or `bottom-[calc(1rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` (`toast.tsx:47-58`).
- overlays are `isolate`d (`dialog.tsx:40`); kbd badges inside tooltips re-isolate at `z-50` (`tooltip.tsx:64`).

## 6. widget inventory

- button (`components/ui/button.tsx`): cva variants default/outline/secondary/ghost/destructive/warning/link; sizes xs h-5, default h-7, sm h-6, lg h-8, icon 5/6/7/8 square; base `rounded-md`, lg+icon-md/lg `rounded-lg`, xs `rounded-sm`; default icon size-3.5; `disabled:opacity-50`; `aria-expanded` mirrors hover.

- tabs (`tabs.tsx`): segmented (default: `bg-muted` list, `p-[3px]`, trigger `rounded-md`, active `bg-background`) or line (transparent, `after` 2px underline `bg-foreground`); height h-8; inactive text 60% fg.
- card/panel: `bg-card border-card-border`, start `rounded-xl`, 16px horizontal padding, selected `bg-card-selected` (`DESIGN.md`).
- dialog (`dialog.tsx`): overlay `fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs duration-100`; content `z-50 rounded-2xl border-popover-border bg-popover p-4 shadow-md`, enter `fade-in-0 zoom-in-95`, ghost icon-sm close button top-4 right-4; `[app-region:no-drag]` for electron.
- toast (`toast.tsx`): `rounded-2xl border bg-toast/60 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg`, 4 positions, variants default/update/info/warning, optional action button `h-8 rounded-md bg-primary px-3`.

- chips/badges (`badge.tsx`): `h-5 rounded-full px-2 text-ui-xs font-medium`, variants default/secondary/destructive (`bg-destructive/10 text-destructive`)/outline/ghost/link; shortcut keycaps via shared `ControlShortcutBadge` (`kbd.tsx`).
- avatar (`avatar.tsx`): sizes sm 6 / default 8 / lg 10, `rounded-full` with `after` hairline border + mix-blend for theme-safe edge, badge dot 2-3 with `ring-2 ring-background`, group overlap `-space-x-2`.
- empty state: plain text row `px-8.5 py-2 text-ui-base text-foreground-subtlest` (`project-sidebar/ProjectTaskRows.tsx:120`); no illustration-heavy empties.
- error rows: chat error banner `rounded-xl bg-surface backdrop-blur-md border border-border px-3 py-2` with collapsible trace pre (`ChatErrorBanner.tsx:270, 344`).
- switch/checkbox: switch 32x18 (sm 28x16) `rounded-full data-checked:bg-primary`, thumb size-4; checkbox `size-4 rounded-sm border-input-border bg-input data-[state=checked]:bg-primary`.
- scrollbars: global 14px track with transparent border-3 pill thumb in `--color-border`, min thumb 32px (`styles.css:843-868`).

## 7. five things a windows 11 styled rival should copy

1. single-variable ui font scale (`--ui-font-size` calc tokens) — the whole app rescales typography without touching geometry; enforcement is a stated design defect, not a preference (`DESIGN.md`, `styles.css:154-166`).
2. alpha-ink border/hover/surface tokens (`rgba(ink,0.10)` etc.) instead of solid grays — borders, hover, selected, surface all derive from one ink per theme, so any accent change stays coherent (`styles.css:531-539, 695-703`).
3. strict three-band overlay stack: content z-10..40, modal+tooltip z-50, interactive overlays z-[60], toasts z-[9999] — makes "menu never under tooltip" structural, not per-case (`dropdown-menu.tsx:45` vs `tooltip.tsx:64` vs `toast.tsx:51`).
4. css-variable-driven shell split with transition-disable-during-drag (`data-[workspace-sidebar-resizing]`) — 60fps sidebar resize with zero react commits (`WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx:2262-2283`).
5. motion contracts per family with reduced-motion parity and one named easing curve set (`--wf-ease cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1)`, wf-t-fast/base/enter/ink = 120/160/200/320ms) — a reusable motion grammar that spans pills, lamps, timeline (`styles.css` wf-motion block).

## five things it should avoid

1. global `*:focus { outline:none !important; box-shadow:none !important }` reset — comment history shows it caused double-ring bugs and accessibility regressions; win11-style apps should keep a real visible focus system (`styles.css:126-139`).
2. one-off arbitrary z-index escape values (`z-[19]`, `z-[61]`, `z-[100]`, `z-[9998]`, `z-[9999]`) — the scale is good but the escape hatch is already leaking; define named tiers instead.
3. theme drift from near-duplicate fallbacks: default light/dark vs zai-light/zai-dark keep ~120 duplicated variables and already needed a regression fix comment (`styles.css:784`); rival should generate variants from one source.
4. prose-locked radius law: the rounded-xl→lg→md→sm nesting counter plus a list of named `rounded-2xl` exceptions is precise but brittle — it needs a whole DESIGN.md section and migration notes to keep sane; prefer fewer levels.
5. wide utilitarian toasts with per-variant bespoke layouts (`update` 300px grid, `source-server-update` 480px, notice 536px with different inner structure in one component) — a rival should unify toast anatomy (`toast.tsx:312-439`).

# design language report: neo.temp captures

## 1. brave (brave.com)

**layout and composition**
- light editorial hero: huge serif display headline ("the browser that puts you first", ~70-100px), one-line bold sans subhead, single pill cta, then an asymmetric 3-card row where the middle card is tinted peach and carries an illustration; giant ghost "brave" watermark behind the hero. evidence: `C:\allan\neo.temp\brave\screenshots\brave.com_index-top.png`.
- markup confirms structure: `section.hero z-10`, `text-display-mobile-hero md:text-display-tablet-hero 2xl:text-display-desktop-hero`, `full-bleed overflow-hidden` sections with vertical rhythm `mt-10 sm:mt-[3.5rem] lg:mt-20` — `C:\allan\neo.temp\brave\pages\brave.com_index.html`.
- density: low-to-medium; full-bleed color bands alternate with `layout` max-width content; faq accordion section (`section#faq`) and card carousel (`assets\brave.com\js\card-carousel...js`, `image-comparison-slider...js`).
- offset hard shadows give a print/collage feel: `--card-shadow:30px 35px 0px var(--card-shadow-color)` and `7px 5px 0px` variants in `C:\allan\neo.temp\brave\assets\brave.com\static-assets\css\main.min.6858b7222fa21cf9ae8355a7003db8d04d84d5411d97cebad71cb03d0398982e.css`.

**color tokens** (from main.min css, rgb-channel primitives)
- primary/blurple scale: `--tw-color-primitive-primary-35:58,46,205`, `-40:67,79,207` (≈#434fcf), `-50:91,103,232` (≈#5b67e8), `-70:150,165,241`; blurple ramp parallel. neutral ramp `neutral-10:28,28,29` (#1c1c1d) to `neutral-100:255,255,255`.
- semantic buttons: `button-background:67,79,207` light / `188,198,243` dark-mode; `button-success-background:28,113,61`; `button-error-background:180,2,14`; `container-interactive:238,242,255` (#eef2ff) light.
- accent orange cta hexes seen 4x each: `#fb542b`, `#ea3a0d`, `#ff7654`, `#fa7250` — used only for the hero download cta and logo moments; ~90% of accent area is blurple/blue, orange is a <=5% highlight. syntax-highlight blues `#a5d6ff`, `#79c0ff` (19+14 occurrences) come from code-embed blocks.
- same file, same evidence path as above.

**typography**
- families: `font-family:FlechaM` (display serif, 115 uses), `Poppins` (68), `Inter Variable` (12); fallback stack `Poppins,Inter Variable,Helvetica,ui-sans-serif...`. fonts shipped: `assets\brave.com\static-assets\fonts\FlechaM\FlechaM-Medium.woff2`, `poppins-latin-{400,500,600,700}-normal.woff2`, `inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2`.
- scale: display `6.25rem`/`7.5rem` (100/120px) desktop hero, `4.375rem` (70px, 38 uses) tablet/section, `5rem` (80px); section heads `2.5rem` (40px) and `1.875rem` (30px, 35 uses); body `1.125rem`/`1rem`; ui `12px`/`14px`/`15px`. same main.min css as evidence.

**motion**
- keyframes: `fade-appear`, `fade-in`, `fade-out`, `pulse`; `@keyframes fade-appear{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}`.
- durations cluster 120-500ms: `--default-transition:box-shadow 0.12s ease-in-out, color 0.12s ease-in-out`, `--transition-duration:var(--leo-collapse-transition-duration, 0.12s)`; hero cta `transition-opacity duration-500` (in page html); accordion `max-height .5s ease-out, opacity .5s ease-out`; menu items `color/transform ... ease-in-out` via `--transition-duration`; one `transition:.15s step-start`. same main.min css.

**z-index scale**
- tiny scale: `-2,-1,0,10,11,15,20,30,40,50`; nav/hero use `z-10`, overlay bands `z-30/40/50`. positioning variables exist per-component (`--card-padding`, `--callout-gutter:1.5rem`, `--bg-hover-mix:5%/10%`), but no global layer token system. same main.min css.

**widget inventory**
- top language banner (dark #1c1c1d bar with blurple pill + ghost dismiss), dropdown nav with chevrons, blurple pill cta + outlined search pill; hero cta pill with download glyph; 3 feature cards (white/peach #fce9e0-ish/lavender #eef2ff) with 1px dark borders and 16px radius (border-radius:16px, 8 uses; `.5rem` 5 uses; `--leo-radius-*` via `--radius`); search-field card with pink magnifier; chip/link lists in lavender card; faq accordion; app-store badge block (`assets\apps.apple.com\...`). evidence: screenshot + main.min css + index html.

**copy five**
1. copy the 100-120px serif display (flecham) against a 30px poppins bold subhead — instant hierarchy.
2. copy the hard offset shadow (`30px 35px 0px`) for hero cards; it photographs well against flat windows chrome.
3. copy the <=5% orange accent budget (one cta per viewport).
4. copy `--bg-hover-mix:5%/10%` color-mix hover pattern for quiet surfaces.
5. copy the 120ms default interaction (`--default-transition`) so hover feels instrument-like.
avoid: 15-item nav with dropdown chevrons on every item; language banner occupying 70px above the nav; giant watermark text (clashes with mica translucency); hard-print shadows at card scale (reads as sticker on acrylic); syntax-highlight palette leaking into marketing chrome.

## 2. trylle (trylle.com, github-like git platform)

**layout and composition**
- dark cinematic hero: centered-left 64-72px heading with silver gradient on the second line, starfield/aurora background image, two ctas (solid green + quiet gray), a fine-print grant line, then a full product screenshot in an app frame peeking below the fold (`--marketing-home-hero-peek-h:min(52.8vh,528px)` and `min(46.8vh,516px)` at lg) — `C:\allan\neo.temp\trylle\pages\trylle.com_index.html`.

**color tokens** (from `C:\allan\neo.temp\trylle\assets\trylle.com\assets\styles-CU_3aHqf.css`, 359kb shadcn/tailwind v4)
- theme is oklch grayscale: light `--background:oklch(100% 0 0)`, `--foreground:oklch(14.1% 0 0)`, `--card:oklch(100% 0 0)`; dark `--background:oklch(14.1% 0 0)`, `--card:oklch(20.5% 0 0)`, `--muted:oklch(16% 0 0)`, `--border:oklch(27.4% 0 0)`.

- accent usage: neutral grays dominate; green appears only in ctas/badges (<5%); alpha-black overlays are the real texture: `#0000001a` (21x), `#0000000d` (9x), white alphas `#ffffff80/#ffffff1a/#ffffff0a` for glass layers. blue `#3b82f6` only inside focus rings (`0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-blue-500,#3b82f6) 35%, transparent)`).

**typography**
- `Inter Variable` for sans, `Geist Mono Variable` for mono/code (both shipped as woff2 in `assets\cdn.trylle.com\marketing\_astro\`); tailwind scale with tight steps: `--text-xs:.75rem`, `--text-sm:.875rem`, `--text-base:1rem`, `--text-lg:1.0625rem`, `--text-xl:1.1875rem`, `--text-2xl:1.375rem`, `--text-3xl:1.625rem`, `--text-4xl:1.875rem`, `--text-5xl:2rem` — small type, dense ui; hero display composed from these at 4xl/5xl with `-0.02em` tracking and `.28em` uppercase eyebrow labels.

**motion**
- 401 transition declarations; durations mostly `s`-scaled with `.2s` (5x), `.15s` (3x), `.3s` (2x), `.1s`, `.5s`; signature easings `cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)` and `cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)` (5x each).
- keyframes: `enter`, `exit` (radix-style), `pulse`, `spin`, `zen-flash`, `detail-banner-shimmer`, `magic-session-task-dot-wave`, `workflow-live-clock-hour/minute`. `--animate-pulse:pulse 2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) infinite`. same styles css.

**z-index scale**
- values: `0,1,2,10,20,30,40,50,51,60,100,101,110,200`; header at 40-50, sticky overlays 100-200; radix portal layers not tokenized (raw numbers). same styles css.

**widget inventory**
- dark glass navbar (blurred bg, `#00000038` gradients), green pill cta; segmented toggle; pricing cards `border-radius:calc(var(--radius) + 4px)`; repo browser chrome card (`rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted`); chips/badges system (`--badge-height:22px/24px`, `--badge-avatar:14px/16px`, `--badge-ring-opacity:.4`); check-list rows; stat band; footer link columns. evidence: styles css + index/pricing pages + screenshots.

**copy five**
1. copy the oklch grayscale theme with a single saturated brand hue — maps perfectly onto win11 neutral surfaces.
2. copy the layered alpha shadows `--ff-shadow-2/3` (inset highlight + 1px ring + drop) for dark-mode cards.
3. copy the `py-24` uniform section rhythm and `@container` scoping.
4. copy the hero "peek" pattern (product screenshot rising from below fold at `min(46.8vh,516px)`).
5. copy `cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)` 200ms for panel transitions.
avoid: starfield/aurora photo backgrounds (fight mica); 400+ one-off transitions (no token discipline); radix portal z-index spikes up to 200 without a layer system; tiny `.75rem` type for marketing body (fails at tv distance); green cta + gold + red chips on one screen (token drift).

# synara design system report

## stack
tailwind v4 (`@import "tailwindcss"`, `@theme inline`) + base-ui components + cva variants. tokens live as css custom properties; a runtime theme engine derives per-theme values from 3-color seeds (surface / ink / accent), explicitly cloning codex electron's chrome derivation.

## color tokens
- seeds (`theme.seed.generated.ts`): default dark surface `#111111`, ink `#fcfcfc`, accent `#0169cc`; light surface `#ffffff`, ink `#0d0d0d`; synara accent `#f2612d` (dark) / `#c74614` (light); diffAdded `#00a240`, diffRemoved `#e02e2a`, skill `#b06dff` (light `#751ed9`). catalog also ships catppuccin (`#1e1e2e`/`#cba6f7`), dracula (`#282a36`/`#ff79c6`), ayu (`#0b0e14`/`#e6b450`), etc. all seeds carry `contrast: 0` ("zero-contrast default").
- static fallbacks (`index.css` `:root`): light background `#fcfcfc`, dark `#0e0e0e`; card = white / `color-mix(background 99%, white)`; border `--alpha(black/5%)` light, `--alpha(white/4%)` dark; input 6%/5%; secondary + muted + accent 3-4% ink alphas; ring neutral-400/neutral-500; destructive red-500; success emerald-500; warning amber-500; `--claude: #d97757`; beta gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #63b3ff 0%, #2e7ff2 55%, #0f5cd6 100%)`.
- dark status tints: each role color mixed 72% toward white (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 72%, var(--color-white))`).
- derived tokens (`theme.logic.ts` `buildLightDerivedTokens`/`buildDarkDerivedTokens`): dark border = ink @ 10% alpha; borderFocus = accent mixed 30% white @ 70% alpha; secondary button = ink @ 4% alpha (hover 6%, active 9%); textForegroundSecondary = ink @ 65%, tertiary 45%; elevatedPrimary = surface+ink 8% @ 96% alpha; simpleScrim ink @ 8%.
- radii: `--radius: 0.625rem`, scale 0.6x-2.6x (`radius-sm` 0.6x ... `radius-4xl` 2.6x); user message 1rem; rail inset `radius*1.3`; dialogs `rounded-3xl`.

## font stacks
- ui: `var(--theme-font-ui-family), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`
- display: `"Cal Sans", var(--font-ui-family)` (single semibold cut, pair with normal weight)
- mono: `"JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace`; terminal: `"JetBrainsMono NFM", "JetBrainsMono NF", "JetBrains Mono", monospace`
- `letter-spacing: normal` on body (native optical metrics, no negative tracking). sizes are settings-scalable (`--text-ui`, `--text-chat`, `--text-chat-code`, plus calc-derived `--text-chat-display: chat*1.6`).

## z-index
css is deliberately shallow: 0-3 for in-page stacking, `-1` for blur-backdrop pseudo-elements, `30` for panes (`index.css`). overlays use tailwind `z-50` (dialog, menu, popover, sheet). toasts are the only high values: viewport `z-[200]`, items `z-[calc(9999-var(--toast-index))]` (`toast.tsx`).

## motion
- enters: `chat-pane-enter 140ms ease-out`, `sidebar-surface-enter 160ms ease-out backwards`, `chat-message-send-enter 180ms ease-out`, `composer-trigger-label-enter 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- layout slides: `300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` (seam fade, rail padding)
- dialogs: `transition-[scale,opacity,translate] duration-200 ease-in-out`, start scale-98, overlay `bg-black/60` 200ms
- toast stack: `[transition:transform_.5s_cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity_.5s,height_.15s]`
- hovers: `background-color 120ms ease`
- stepped spinners at 50ms cadence: `spin-stepped 1.3s steps(26, end)` and `2.6s steps(52, end)`; shimmer `2s steps(40, end)`; skeleton `2s linear`; terminal pulse `640ms ease-in-out`
- every custom animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disable.

## widget class patterns
- contract: base-ui `data-slot` attributes (`data-slot="button"`, `"input"`, `"menu-item"`, `"empty"`, `"toast-viewport"`, `"toast-title"`) + cva variant maps.
- button (`button.tsx`): documented taxonomy filled (default/secondary/destructive/prominent/circle), outlined (outline/primary-outline/secondary-outline/destructive-outline/chrome-outline), ghostly (ghost/chrome/subtle/link); sizes chip→xl paired 1:1 with icon sizes so text and icon buttons share toolbar baselines (`h-9 sm:h-8` default, `size-9 sm:size-8` icon); explicit comment: "intentionally flat - no drop shadows, no inset highlights"; hover is alpha swap `[:hover,[data-pressed]]:bg-primary/90`; focus `ring-1 ring-ring/60 ring-offset-1`; `pointer-coarse:after:min-h-11` 44px touch targets; `prominent` = `rounded-full hover:scale-105 duration-150`.
- input (`input.tsx`): wrapper `data-slot="input-control"` + inner `data-slot="input"`; fill `--input` (ink 5-6% alpha).
- dialog (`dialog.tsx`): `rounded-3xl border-[--color-border-light] bg-popover shadow-[0_16px_50px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.34)]` (0.7 dark); nested dialogs scale/fade via `--nested-dialogs` multiplier.
- toast (`toast.tsx`): fixed viewport with 6 data-position corners, measured stacked heights, archive-undo special surface.
- menu/picker (`index.css` 3502-3620): `.composer-picker-menu-surface` = `color-mix(in oklab, var(--popover) 70%, transparent)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(32px)`; density tokens per size (`--picker-option-min-h: 1.625rem` normal / `1.5rem` small) sized via `data-slot` selectors.
- empty (`empty.tsx`): EmptyHeader/EmptyMedia/EmptyTitle/EmptyDescription/EmptyContent slots; icon variant stacks two rotated card tiles (`rotate-10` / `-rotate-10 scale-84`) behind the glyph.
- chip (`status-chip.tsx`): `size-1.5 rounded-full` dot, optional `animate-pulse`.

## five things a windows 11 styled rival should copy
1. seed-derived token engine: 3 hex seeds generate every surface/button/border/focus token per variant with alpha-ink math (`theme.logic.ts`) - trivially retargetable to a windows palette.
2. flat button contract with the taxonomy comment in-source (`button.tsx` lines 15-38): hover = fill alpha swap, no shadows, paired text/icon sizes, 44px pointer-coarse hit expansion.
3. motion budget: 120-240ms ease-out enters, one spring-like curve (`0.32, 0.72, 0, 1`) for layout, reduced-motion guards, stepped spinners aligned to 50ms frames for compositor efficiency.
4. `data-slot` + cva as the component contract: styleable from css via attribute selectors instead of class plumbing, enabling the density-token pattern (`.composer-picker-menu--small`).
5. hairline craft: gradient-painted 1px dividers that never affect layout (`index.css` `.chat-surface-divider`), `0.5px` retina borders on the rail, and seam/divider tokens kept distinct with rationale comments.

## five things to avoid
1. mac-first translucency: `backdrop-filter` gating that disables blur on windows because chromium rasterizes blurred layers wrong at fractional DPI (`theme.logic.ts` lines 909-916) - a windows 11 app should make mica/acrylic first-class, not a mac-only leftover.
2. near-zero contrast chrome: borders at 4-5% ink alpha and `contrast: 0` default; windows 11's design language relies on visible 1px strokes and layered elevation, which this system actively suppresses.
3. `-apple-system`-first font stack and mac-tuned geometry (`rounded-3xl` dialogs, 0.5px hairlines) tuned for retina; windows 11 wants `Segoe UI Variable`, 4/8px control radii, and dpr-robust border widths.
4. toasts stacking via `z-[calc(9999-var(--toast-index))]` and per-item measured heights - fragile imperative stacking for what windows already owns as a system surface.
5. 300-600 character tailwind class strings inside tsx (`dialog.tsx` line 55, `button.tsx` variants) with `[:hover,[data-pressed]]` pseudo-compound selectors - unreadable and unportable; keep states in css.

## 2. pages deploy: when it broke

- the workflow file itself is healthy. its last changes are benign maintenance bumps: `88379787` (v2.0.133, 10-21) and `4e2f210c` (v2.0.134, 10-22) only moved pnpm 12.14.0→12.15.0 and node 26.12.0→26.12.1 inside pages.yml (verified by diff). before that, `52e1ae0a` ("the four red lanes return green") explicitly repaired the pages legs (the devthink bun leg gained `--ignore-scripts`, line 125) — that was the last certified green state of the pages lane, and the two rungs after it landed through green pr pipelines (the ladder merges only green).
- last green state: the rung v2.0.134 era (`4e2f210c`, 10-22). after that, the 10-23 wave bypassed all pr gates (direct pushes — see section 3) and pages fired on every push.
- the breaking change: `ecaef71b` "design(argan)" and `474ec795` "design(getry)", both dated 2026-10-23 20:44, added root-level `trustedDependencies` arrays to `argan/package.json` and `getry/package.json` (trusting `better-sqlite3`, `esbuild`, `@tailwindcss/oxide`, `prisma`, `@prisma/engines`, `ssh2`, `workerd`, `cpu-features`, `protobufjs`). both apps carry `better-sqlite3 ^13.0.3` as a direct dependency, so pnpm now executes its native gyp build on the runner.
- why that kills pages: the pages pnpm leg runs `pnpm --dir "<app>" install --frozen-lockfile` with no `--ignore-scripts` (`pages.yml` line 139), unlike the bun leg (line 125) and the saddle npm leg (`saddle/.npmrc` carries `ignore-scripts=true`, "the sqlite lottery dies here"). `52e1ae0a` documented this exact lottery as broken on runners ("the prebuild mirror and the broken bunx node-gyp fallback the six plan legs and the pages leg died on"). the argan and getry build legs therefore go red; `fail-fast: false` keeps siblings alive but `assemble` needs the whole build matrix, so assemble and deploy are skipped — the site stops deploying. at least two pages runs fired after 20:44 (`24fc6c66` cobaia, `3122606a` stealthhead 21:09), so the first red run is that evening's.
- eliminated suspects (checked, not the break): the two-document structure of 8 family pnpm locks is pnpm 12's own output (regenerated by `7b6c0f52`, 10-20, and lanes were green after); tailwind wiring is complete in all 11 apps (css import + `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin + package); `@tailwindcss/vite` is declared in devthink devDependencies and lock; `devthink/index.html` is well-formed; the configs parity gate answers green; the rung version bumps are benign.
- secondary risks in the same wave: `a40ef352` added `tailwindcss ^4.1.0` to devthink dependencies while devDependencies already carries `^4.3.3` (duplicate pin, devdeps wins today); pages.yml `concurrency: cancel-in-progress: true` cancelled most wave runs wholesale (cosmetic, but it hides which leg actually failed).

## 3. commit signing: when and how the verified chain stopped

- the "verification signature" of this repo is not gpg — it is github's web-flow signature. only commits github creates server-side (squash merges) carry it. evidence: every signed-looking commit on main shows `%G? E, key B5690EEEBB952194` — that is github's web-flow key id, not a local key. the vehicle is documented in `.github/COMMITSIGNING.md` ("the wave lands on a branch, the pull request runs the battery, the squash merge signs the arrival") and implemented in `devthink/tests/scripts/signedlanding.ts` (npm script `land:signed`), which stages a dated branch, opens a pr, squash-merges with the owner token and "refuses to answer success until the github api itself confirms the landed commit verified true". the maintenance ladder lands its rungs the same way (`maintenance.yml` lines 266-375).
- the break point: the last verified commit on main is `00b66b83` (10-23, "the wave of the official documents lands ... the signed lineage", web-flow signed). the very next commit `248dbe79` (10-23) and all 21 commits after it up to the tip `3122606a` are direct local pushes — `%G? N`, no signature. direct pushes can never be verified (the repository token owns no signing key; a local key is not registered on the account).
- what changed: nothing in the repo broke — the operator stopped using the vehicle. the 10-23 design wave (17 commits) was pushed straight to main instead of riding the branch + pr + squash path. plausible motive visible in the same window: the wave also carried the changes that redden the battery (the pages break of section 2, the new configs gate), and the vehicle's optional `--wait` mode (and the ladder's own gate) refuses to land over a red pipeline — a red battery forces the choice between fixing first or pushing unsigned. correlation is certain, causation is probable.
- the gpg key in `.github/commitkey.asc` is a separate, dead lineage: ed25519 key `B51C07367CBBB16BD6F1047D6FE8EEE06D2374A7` (uid "ghenho akadion"), created 2026-10-23 — the same day — and committed by `00b66b83`. no workflow in `.github/workflows/` imports it (zero references across the entire history: only `00b66b83` ever touched the string "commitkey"), the local and global git config carry no `commit.gpgsign` / `user.signingkey`, and the historical signed commits were made with github's web-flow key, not this one. the "verification workflow in .github" the owner remembers does not exist as a file; the verification machinery is (a) the vehicle script, (b) the ladder's squash path, (c) verify.yml as the pr gate.

## 5. why the test counts swing (62, then 44, then 27)

the repo has no single test owner; four overlapping batteries fire on different conditions, and the number the owner reads (the checks list / step counts of a run) changes with the firing type:

- what runs on a push to main, always: devthink ci (7 check entries: cli-runtime matrix x3 node/bun/deno + lts-typecheck + static-web + structure + webpack), devthink verify (5: the 58-step ladder + modes matrix x3 + consumer), family configs (1), devthink security (17 entries on push, including skipped-shown dependency-review and rust-audit), devthink maintenance via workflow_run (3: propose, cachecleanup, retire). subtotal 33.
- path filters add: family pages (13 entries: 11 build legs + assemble + deploy) only when an app folder or pages.yml changed; workflow lint (1) only when `.github/workflows/**` changed; devthink release (16 jobs) only when the version files changed (`package.json`, `devthink/package.json`, `devthink/CHANGELOG.md`).
- the mapping: a maintenance rung push (touches `devthink/package.json` + changelog + app tree) = 33 + 13 (pages) + 16 (release) = 62. an ordinary wave push touching app folders only = 33 + 13 = 46 ≈ the reported 44 (±2 from skip-display of needs-cascade jobs). a pull request (the maintenance ladder's pr, or any pr) drops pages and release and adds dependency-review + labeler + workflowlint ≈ 29-31 ≈ the reported 27.
- inside a single run the count also differs per matrix leg by design: the ci node leg runs bundle-surface asserts (no vitest), the bun leg runs the full vitest suite (`devthink/tests` = 163 files, 2808 cases), the deno leg builds and type-checks only; the pages legs each run install+build, and only the devthink leg runs the boot smoke and html lint.
- the app suites never run in ci at all: the ten family apps carry 140 test files (~1790 cases) and vitest configs, but no workflow invokes them — `configs.yml` runs `configparity.mjs` only. so commits that move tests between `devthink/tests` and app tests folders (e.g. `5b62decc`, "the family scripts live inside the os app tests and the app tests folders") shift what the one running suite counts while the total test mass is unchanged. this is the scattered logic the owner suspects: three batteries (verify ladder, ci runtime legs, pages smokes) plus an orphaned app-suite layer, with no single correlated owner.
- caveat: exact 62/44/27 mapping needs one actions run list (`gh run view`) to confirm the ±2 skip-display noise; the mechanisms above are verified from the workflow files themselves.

## Seam 4 — Auth/account creation reality + OAuth plug points + callback app

**Local account (why "account creation does not work"):** Sol\widgets\auth.signin.tsx:191 "Create account and sign in" → Sol\auth\auth.tsx:100-117 `createEntry` → accountgate.ts:41-46 `createAccount`: salt = local deviceId, stores SHA-256 `deviceId:digest` in the **browser IndexedDB `credentials` store** (`ACCOUNT_CREDENTIAL_ID = "devthink.account"`, accountgate.ts:15,44).
