**What actually is real today:** the local CLI pairing flow — server routes POST `/pairings/consume` (server.ts:218-232, returns bearer token + userId) and `/pairings/revoke` (:256-257), bearer verified per origin (`verifyBrowserSession`, server.ts:234-235), identity endpoints `/identity` GET/PUT (:237-255). The browser side stores the token in sessionStorage (gateway.ts:8-31, Sol\auth\auth.tsx:152-158). This is a single-person localhost CLI↔browser pairing, not multi-user accounts. Separate: `accounts.ts:1-30` is the Antigravity **LLM provider** Google-account manager (OAuth to Gemini CLI, token files under ~/.config) — unrelated to platform users.

**OAuth provider row (wired but dead-ended):** oauthrow.ts:18-57 — google/github/gitlab, authorize endpoints, scopes, client-id envs `VITE_OAUTH_GOOGLE_ID/_GITHUB_ID/_GITLAB_ID`, callback env `VITE_OAUTH_CALLBACK`, default **`OAUTH_CALLBACK_DEFAULT = "https://auth.devthink.pro/callback"`** (oauthrow.ts:47). Readiness is honest: `providerRow()` (oauthrow.ts:81-107) marks a provider ready only when its env client id exists; **.env.example contains no VITE_OAUTH_* vars** → all rows render disabled (auth.tsx:178-180, 207). When started: state mint + PKCE, verifier parked in sessionStorage (auth.tsx:183-190), redirect via `window.location.assign(buildAuthorizeUrl(...))` (auth.tsx:190).

**The dead end:** the receiving page Sol\callback\callback.tsx:27-75 renders an honest verdict — error / "received" (with provider from state marker, oauthrow.ts:147) / unknown — and **performs no token exchange, creates no session, writes nothing** ("the token exchange lands with the gateway wave" = future work, callback.tsx:14-16). The parked PKCE verifier is never consumed.

**OAuth callback app `C:\allan2\devthink\domain.bot.ouath.auth.app`: EMPTY.** No package.json, no source, no endpoints. Git-tracked content = 141 files, of which **139 are `.mimosa/` tooling metadata** and only 2 real files (`.zcode/plans/plan-….md` — Portuguese doc-absorption notes, not app specs — and `.zcodeignore`). Commit messages are "fefe/fefefe". **Readiness: 0%.** It is the intended target of `auth.devthink.pro/callback` but currently cannot answer anything; the exchange endpoint, client secret handling and session issuing all need to be built there (or the callback hosted inside devthink at `/callback`, which already exists as a page).

**Where a real OAuth flow plugs in:** (1) env vars `VITE_OAUTH_GOOGLE_ID` etc. + `VITE_OAUTH_CALLBACK` (oauthrow.ts:38-47); (2) an exchange endpoint (none exists; server.ts is the natural home near :986); (3) the session creator to replace `finish()` in callback.tsx:52-57; (4) a real user store — vault's sqlite or prisma, neither currently reachable from the browser flow.

**Today: per-app file DBs, no shared identity.** Each app's `db.ts` defaults to its own file: vault `file:./vault.db` (vault\db.ts:19), forge\foundry\cobaia `file:./<app>.db` (foundry\db.ts:19, cobaia\db.ts:19), argan/cadria/debonair `file:./local.db` (argan\db.ts:27, cadria\db.ts:21, debonair\db.ts:22), stealthhead `file:./stealthhead.db` (db.ts:14-32), getry better-sqlite3 over `DATABASE_URL` (getry\db.ts:309-324), saddle same pattern (db.ts). ## Executive summary of fakes (for the implementation waves)

1. **Storage:** everything persists in the visitor browser (IndexedDB `devthink.db` + ~15 localStorage keys) despite the written doctrine; no server storage is reachable from the UI. Vault (the real storage engine) is never imported.
2. **Sandbox button:** 100% client-side simulation from `saddle/sandbox.ts` (alias-resolved sibling file); boots instantly with fabricated dmesg; `dispatch()` interprets commands against an in-memory VFS; no fetch, no worker, no VM. Saddle's real 24-modality registry/VM modules (qemu/firecracker/docker targets) are unreferenced by devthink; modality counts disagree everywhere (24 actual / 30 "modes" / 40 owner / 50 docs).
3. **2GB quota:** no such constant exists in any app; UI shows the browser's `navigator.storage.estimate()`.
4. **Accounts:** local-only (salted digest in browser IndexedDB); OAuth rows exist and are honest-but-disabled (no client-id envs), callback page stops at "received" with no exchange; the designated callback app `domain.bot.ouath.auth.app` contains zero code (0% ready).
5. **Family DB:** 11 separate sqlite files; only forge/foundry link vault (`file:../vault`); "one login everywhere" needs the shared auth + vault session store that don't exist yet.
6. **Packages:** uniform version 2.0.141 and ~70 shared deps; cobaia lags on 9 pins; saddle spec drift (^2.1.6 vs 2.0.141); packageManager fragmented (bun/npm/pnpm/none).
7. **Nav:** floating-by-default with working left/right dock toggle already shipped (desktopstate.ts + settings.navbarposition.tsx + shell.shellchrome.tsx + sol.css:16336+).

Root also holds two network captures: `chatgpt-net.ndjson` (208 lines, full req/res/body of a chatgpt.com session incl. pt-BR UI strings) and `zai-net.ndjson` (38 lines, z.ai).

Classification of every folder:

- **SCRAPED site captures (17)** — each has `assets/`, `pages/*.html`, `screenshots/*-full/-top/-menu.png`, `manifest.json`: `60fps` (60fps.design micro-interaction gallery), `brave`, `chatgpt`, `details`, `fluent2` (fluent2.microsoft.design), `fluxweave`, `linear` (5 pages), `navbar-gallery`, `openai`, `sombra`, `suno`, `transitions` (transitions.dev), `trylle` (the design the Sol type system calls "the trylle ruler"), `uilabs`, `v86`, `windows-ui`, `zai`. **`webflow/` is empty** (assets/pages/screenshots all zero).
- **SINGLE-PAGE demos (16)** — `index.html` + `assets/`: `easingwizard` (easing gallery), `oklch` (color), `gsap`, `motion`, `radix`, `shadcn`, `mobbin`, `devouringdetails`, `arena`, `fluentacrylic`, `fontshare`, `grok`, `sumo`, `supaste`, `utopia`, `vellum`.
- **Special**: `acrylicmica/` — `acrylic.html`, `mica.html`, `noise.png`, `clouds.jfif`, `Inter.var.woff2`, `readme.md` (Fluent acrylic/mica recipes — directly useful for shader/glass work); `dom/` — DOM snapshots `chatgpt-root.dom.json`, `chatgpt-ui.dom.json`, `zai-root.dom.json`, `zai-ui.dom.json`; `shots/` — ChatGPT UI screenshots.
- **Rust repos (11)**: `Seelen-UI`, `goose`, `opencut`, and the **storytold product family**: `storytold-artcraftx/-designcraft/-effectcraft/-filmcraft/-lightcraft/-photocraft/-printcraft/-vectorcraft` (full Cargo workspaces — the sibling Craft apps).
- **JS repos (~36)**: `t3code` (28k files), `microsoft-ui-xaml`, `WinUI-Gallery`, `fluentui`, `fluent-svelte`, `zcode`, `remotion`, `litellm`, `omniroute`, `hyperframes`, `daytona`, `jan`, `puter`, `openhands`, `opensandbox`, `e2b`, `playcanvas-engine`, `pascalorg-editor`, `mediabunny`, `otio.js`, `gl-transitions` (GLSL shader transitions), the **web-desktop OS set** `osjs` + `osjs-client/-gui/-panels/-theme`, `win11`, `win11React`, `win11web`, `winclone`, `windows-11-os`, `windows113`, `react-windows-ui`, `reactwin11`, `synara`, `daedal`, `vgpu`, `progpu` (C#/.NET), `celestastudio`, `claude-of-duty`, `pulsegridstudio`, `rendiv`, `motionforge`, `dnssec-js`, `pnpmtest`.
- **OTHER**: `fluentdesign` (acrylic, loadingAnimation, navigationBar, scrollbar samples), `blender`, `comfyui`, `audiocraft`, `stableaudiotools`, `laya`, `llm2jev`, `muse-jev-playbook`, `typellm`, `video-use`, `autoclip`, `compositor`, `external-dns`, `strudel`.

Most important pieces for a webflow-awards-level redesign: the micro-interaction/transition galleries (`60fps`, `transitions`, `easingwizard`, `uilabs`, `sombra`, `devouringdetails`, `navbar-gallery`), the glass/shader recipes (`acrylicmica`, `fluentdesign`, `gl-transitions`), chat-grade UI references (`chatgpt` scrape + `dom/` + `shots/` + ndjson, `zai`, `grok`), and OS-shell references (`osjs*`, `win11*`, `Seelen-UI`, `fluentui`/`WinUI-Gallery`). The companion design doctrine lives outside the corpus at `C:\allan\neo.skills\design-premium\SKILL.md` + `references/` (13 Laws, style/effect/motion catalogs, anti-vibe-code ban lists, FLUXO-7 pipeline, render-proof gate).

## (b) Sol component roster

Architecture is 3 layers (documented in `Sol\Sol.tsx:1-11`): `Sol.tsx` (theme anchor + router, `C:\allan\devthink\devthink\Sol\Sol.tsx`) imports 27 page anchors; each `Sol/<page>/<page>.tsx` is the page path manager; all loose components live in `Sol/widgets/` behind a single barrel `Sol\widgets\index.ts`. `App.tsx` consumes only Sol.tsx + sol.css (`App.tsx:21`). Path alias `@/*` → `./Sol/*` + `./*` (`tsconfig.json:15`).

Routes (`Sol.tsx:95-130`): `/` intro, `/onboarding`, `/panel` (OS desktop, also all `/w/:workspaceId/...` deep routes and family slugs), `/auth`, `/callback`, `/chat`, `/files`, `/video`, `/audio`, `/image`, `/calculator`, `/games`, `/console`, `/gateway` (+`/gateway/v/:versionId`), `/providers`, `/projects`, `/usage`, `/docs`, `/explore`, `/history`, `/settings`, `/about`, `/plans`, `/terms`, `/policy`, `/404` catch-all.

**DOTS: every one of the 97 widget files has a dot in the name** (page-prefixed, e.g. `chat.body.tsx`). The barrel header (`widgets/index.ts:1-7`) states this is deliberate: the dotted file name is imported exactly once, in the barrel. `index.ts` is the only undotted file.

## Plate material (the shared upgrade)

- **Three-stop identity gradient** replacing the two-stop: lit cap (`shade(top, +.2)`), pure registry tint through the body, deep base — baked into the `-tone` gradient so glyph cutouts sample the *exact* face color (the old overlay-sheen made cutouts slightly mismatched; that defect is gone). - **Rim light + grounded shade**: two clipped inner strokes — white fade along the top shoulders, soft black occlusion along the bottom edge. No gloss, no grain, no tinted glow (ban lists respected).
- **Live sheen sweep**: a clipped specular band (`dtIconSheen`) driven by the existing `data-live` flag from `apptile.tsx` — one 480ms pass on `--ease-micro`, guarded by both `prefers-reduced-motion` and the file's `[data-motion="reduced"]` convention. ## Client module — `C:\allan\devthink\devthink\sandboxclient.ts` (new, dot-free, `@section` JSDoc per house law)

- **Types**: `SandboxServerRow { line }`, `SandboxServerAnswer { rows, exitcode, durationms, tool }` (mirrors sandboxlane's wire shapes, validated before use — a wrong-shaped body is null).
- **Surface**: `boot(sessionid)` → POST `/api/v1/sandbox/session`; `run(sessionid, line)` → POST `/api/v1/sandbox/run`; `files(sessionid)` → GET `/api/v1/sandbox/files?sessionId=`; `modalities()` → GET `/api/v1/sandbox/modalities`. All answer `... | null`.
- **Base resolution**: the paired gateway context first (`gatewayContext()` — the guarded `?gateway=` base plus its ephemeral bearer), else the chat's registered gateway preference (`readBrowserPreferences()[PREF_GATEWAYBASE]` through `normalizeGatewayBase`). No base → null without touching the wire.
- **Bounds**: one shared `sandboxfetch` — AbortController at 10 s, bearer rides the pairing token, null on no-base / network error / timeout / non-ok / unreadable body. No localStorage, no new dependency, no hardcoded origin; session ids gated client-side by the route's own pattern.

## How the pane picks server vs fallback (`C:\allan\devthink\devthink\Sol\widgets\ChatSandboxpane.tsx`)

- Per-mount lane state: `laneref` (`idle | server | local`), an ephemeral session id ref (generated once, stored nowhere), and an offline-declared ref.
- **Boot**: prints the intro row, tries `boot()` first. A server answer renders its rows verbatim (boot class) plus the existing `sb.running` ok row, lamp goes running. Null → the offline declaration, then the existing simulator boot (spec commit, dmesg) byte-for-byte unchanged.
- **Commands** (command well and bridge — one executor, `execlane`): cmdline row prints first, then server mode tries `run()` for every command except `run` itself, which rides the dedicated `modalities()` route — so the modality report renders the real server host rows when online. Server rows join and render exactly like local rows with the exit code honored (ok/err classes); the `clear` tool wipes the log. A null answer falls to the local engine (created lazily on first fall) through the same declaration.
- **Offline row wording**: `offline: the lane answers locally — the deployed copy carries the server lane.` — printed with the boot row class **once per pane session** (mount lifetime), covering both boot fallback and a mid-session lane fall; never per command. Stop resets the lane to idle so the next boot retries the server.

## The account surface

**`accountlane.ts`** (new, root, JSDoc `@section`, dot-free) — server-side accounts over the same seam as `storagelane.ts`: `sharedatabasedriver()` (node:sqlite/bun:sqlite), file at `join(dirname(resolvePaths().database), "devthink-accounts.sqlite")` — the data home beside the storage store, outside every served root. Tables: `accounts (id, owner UNIQUE, salt, digest, createdat)` and `accountssessions (token, accountid, createdat, expiresat)`. Secrets: scrypt digest (64-byte key) bound to a random 32-byte hex salt per account; `timingSafeEqual` on verify; the session bearer (randomBytes(32) hex) is stored **only as its sha-256 digest** — no plaintext secret stored or logged. Surface: `createaccount`, `verifyaccount` (returns the record or null — absent/malformed refuse identically, no oracle), `issueaccountsession` (30-day family TTL), `verifyaccountsession`, `revokeaccountsession`, `accountfor`, `normalizeaccountowner`, `prepareaccounts`, `AccountError`. The JSDoc states the family law: a deploy pointing the shared data home or `DATABASE_URL` at the same store logs the whole family in with one session.

**Routes in `server.ts`** (same guards as the storage/onboarding neighbors — regex shape gates, `.catch(() => null)` body reads, honest statuses): `POST /api/v1/accounts` (create + session, 409 taken / 400 shape), `POST /api/v1/accounts/session` (signin, 401 mismatch), `GET /api/v1/accounts/session` (bearer summary), `DELETE /api/v1/accounts/session` (revoke, 401 when absent), `POST /api/v1/auth/exchange` (provider/catalog, code, verifier, optional redirectUri → 201 with the family session; AccountError→400, GateError→502). Boot calls `await prepareaccounts()` beside the copy-seed ingestion.

## The exchange flow end to end

auth face → `mintPkcePair` + verifier parked in sessionStorage (existing) → provider redirects to `/callback` → **`Sol/callback/callback.tsx` now completes it**: reads the parked verifier via `oauthVerifierKey`, POSTs `exchangeoauthcode` through the new **`accountclient.ts`** (base resolution identical to `sandboxclient.ts`: paired gateway context, then the registered gateway preference; 10 s bound; ok/refused/offline verdict union) → server validates provider against the oauthrow catalog (extended with `OAUTH_TOKEN_ENDPOINTS` + `OAUTH_PROFILE_ENDPOINTS`), exchanges the code at the token endpoint **through the url gate**, fetches the profile with the bearer, upserts the account by provider identity (`google-<sub>` normalized owner; a random nobody-knows secret for oauth-only accounts), issues the family session → the page saves it to `localStorage` (`devthink.account.token/owner`), burns the parked verifier, renders the signed-in face; refusal and offline faces render from new `callback.*` copy rows (the `received.note` was updated to stay honest — it still contains "gateway" per the copy law test).

## The gate without a hostname literal

**`urlgate.ts`**: http/https only, credentials refuse; **every** hostname goes through `node:dns/promises` `lookup(host, { all: true, verbatim: true })` and **every resolved address must be public** — classified from the resolved octets (v4) and expanded groups (v6, incl. embedded-v4 tails): loopback, private, link-local, unique-local, v4-mapped/v4-compatible, this-network, CGNAT, benchmark, documentation, NAT64, discard-only, multicast/reserved/broadcast all refuse **by ADDRESS**; a non-resolving host refuses. No name-based check, no allowlist, zero hostname literals in the module (even the classification comments avoid them). `gatedrequest`: redirects held manual, every hop re-gated (cross-origin hops drop caller headers), 303/301/302 downgrade to GET, byte cap (`MAXANSWERBYTES`, enforced by content-length and incremental stream read), wall-clock cap (`GATETIMEOUTMS`), `GateError` for every refusal.

## Offline fallback and settings

`Sol/auth/auth.tsx`: create/sign-in are **server-first**; on `refused` the verdict row answers (a taken owner with a matching secret signs in); on `offline` the local `accountgate` runs as the **declared** fallback with the honest row (`auth.account.offline` copy). `settings.accountscategory` gained a Family-session card — real `GET /accounts/session` state (owner/since/expires) with the sign-out action wired to DELETE + local clear, and the honest "no live session" row otherwise.

**Module surface** — `C:\allan\devthink\devthink\devtoolsguard.ts` is now THE single dot-free module (JSDoc `@section` headers, `@depends-on`/`@consumed-by`):
- `installdevtoolsguard(options?)` — arms in PROD only (`guardarmed()` gate; dev machine keeps its tools), idempotent, never un-suspends a standing suspension; returns the disarm (flips the suspend seam and parks)
- `suspenddevtoolsguard(bool)` — the toggle seam; answers on every build; true parks every loop (never loops while suspended), false restarts the duty cycle when armed and untripped
- `devtoolsguardstatus()` / `devtoolstripped()` — status readers (snapshot `{armed, suspended, tripped}`)
- `ondevtoolstrip(listener)` — listeners now receive the dotted signal id (App wires the strike report through it)
- `showdevtoolsinterstitial()` / `devtoolswallid()` — the trip response
- Prongs: bracketed `debugger` trap at the study's 1200 ms with a 60 ms pause budget (brackets hug the statement, so setTimeout overshoot never counts), riding a duty cycle (4-tick burst, equal rest — both prongs share one timer chain); console-getter probe created once, only ever handed to `console.log("%c", probe)`, never self-read. Window-size heuristic absent entirely.

**Trip response** — one fixed overlay (`id=dtdevtoolswall`, class `dt-devtools-wall`) appended to the body via `appendChild`, carrying `osText()` copy from new `guard.wall.*` rows in `oslabels.ts`; append-only, idempotent, role `alertdialog`; never a wipe, never a loop, never a history flood. On trip the duty cycle parks (rest-after-trip), the interstitial stands, then listeners fire. Skinned in sol.css §AA (appended after the craft-pass end marker): tokens only (`--dt-base/-text/-muted/-panel/-edge/-mono`, `--z-modal` step, `--sol-error`, `--glass-*`), one quiet rise stopped by both `[data-motion="reduced"]` forms and the media query, plus the reduced-transparency law; the module also stamps `data-motion="reduced"` on the element itself.

**Toggle behavior** — `SettingsPersonalstore.ts` gains `DEVTOOLS_WALL_KEY = "dt.devtools.wall.v1"` with `loadDevtoolsWall()` (fallback **true** — default ON), `saveDevtoolsWall()`, `applyDevtoolsWall()` (calls `suspenddevtoolsguard(!on)`); `initPersonalization()` applies it on boot — the settings anchor module loads inside App's import graph, so a stored "off" suspends the prongs before `installdevtoolsguard()` runs in `App()` (install respects standing suspension by design).
